title: 《漫威金刚狼》官方解释红色追踪线：是嗅觉轨迹
text:
合理引导
如果你一直关注《漫威金刚狼》最新实机演示公开后的讨论，可能已经注意到，很多争议都围绕着游戏里的一条红线展开。
Insomniac这款即将登陆PS5的独占游戏展示了这样一段玩法：金刚狼在马德里坡的屋顶上追逐邪恶忍者犯罪组织「手合会」的成员。目标身后会留下发光的红色追踪轨迹，让金刚狼——以及玩家——能够更容易看清目标逃跑的方向，并继续展开追击。
不过，有玩家认为，这条红线对玩家的引导过于明显。
类似此前围绕《最终幻想》「黄色油漆指引」产生的讨论，一些玩家认为，《漫威金刚狼》的这条红线几乎消除了追逐过程中原本可能需要的操作判断，因此这段玩法最后很可能只会变成一个无聊、近似固定路线的演出桥段。
当然，这条红线本身就是一种导航辅助。默认开启的情况下，它显然会让这部分玩法变得更简单，因为玩家可以直接看到并沿着它追踪。
不过，至少从游戏世界观来看，罗根追着这样一条红线跑是有解释的：它实际上是在视觉上表现这名变种人极其强大的追踪能力，而这种能力来自他异常敏锐的嗅觉。只要稍微了解金刚狼这个角色，就会知道他经常会通过闻空气中的气味，判断危险拐角后究竟有什么人或东西。同样，当目标逃跑时，他也能够通过气味锁定对方去向。
因此，玩家在画面中看到的其实是一条「气味轨迹」，也可以理解成金刚狼超强嗅觉能力的一种可视化表现，让玩家能够沿着这条轨迹进行追踪。
不过，这里仍然存在一些疑问。比如，这条红线是否属于辅助功能？如果是，玩家能不能把它关闭？Insomniac目前公布的《漫威金刚狼》辅助功能列表中，包括一项名为「追逐辅助（Chase Assist）」的选项。玩家可以通过它降低追逐场景中目标的移动速度。这项功能是否也会同时控制红色追踪线，目前还不确定。
另外，《漫威金刚狼》的辅助功能中还包含多种导航选项。玩家可以显示一条指向最近敌人或任务目标的方向轨迹，甚至能够自行设定轨迹颜色。从世界观角度来说，这同样可以简单解释为罗根本身就是一个拥有动物般追踪能力的人。不过，这类导航辅助已经确认可以关闭。
对于这段追逐玩法，不少玩家恐怕已经形成了自己的看法，而在距离游戏发售只剩几周的情况下，Insomniac想要改变这些人的印象并不容易。
实际上，有关这段追逐玩法的批评已经在社交媒体上迅速传播。X上有一条批评相关实机画面的帖子浏览量接近100万次，随后有另一名玩家指出，红线其实可以用金刚狼的嗅觉能力来解释。
Insomniac社区与市场负责人James Stevenson对此只回复了一个词：「正解。」
总之，《漫威金刚狼》将于9月15日发售，我们到时候就能知道具体的情况了。

title: 《控制：共振》开发商宣布实体版发售日期延期
text:
延期至10月
《控制：共振》在发售前遭遇临时延期，但此次调整只会影响实体版。
这款《控制》续作仍将于9月24日以数字版形式登陆PC、PS5和XBOX Series，不过想购买实体版的玩家现在需要等到10月15日才能玩到。
开发商Remedy在社交媒体发布声明表示：「准备好在9月24日于扭曲的曼哈顿释放Dylan Faden的超自然能力吧。我们还需要一点时间才能把实体版送到大家手中，不过请放心——没有什么能够永远被封锁。」
好的一面是，如果你准备等到10月再玩《控制：共振》，那么你就能有更多时间体验同样会在9月发售的大量游戏，包括《漫威金刚狼》《火焰纹章 万缕千丝》《沙丘：觉醒》《寂静岭：Townfall》《我的世界：地下城2》等。
而且，在《GTA6》于11月19日发售之前，玩家仍然有超过一个月时间可以通关《控制：共振》。
本月早些时候，Remedy负责人Jean-Charles Gaudechon在面向投资者时表示，公司希望把《控制：共振》定位成一款「首日必买」的作品，同时进一步将《控制》打造为长期发展的系列。
在去年多人游戏实验性作品《FBC：Firebreak》之后，Remedy目前也在寻求稳定公司的财务状况。Gaudechon表示：「在竞争激烈的秋季档期中，我们相信这款游戏本身的独特性和品质能够让它脱颖而出。」
如果玩家购买的是实体光盘版，那么这次所谓的「首日购买」现在确实要晚一些。不过从目前公开的信息来看，《控制：共振》仍然很有希望成为一款值得期待的续作。
IGN在今年早些时候实际试玩后表示：「《控制：共振》目前看起来基本就是它表面呈现的样子，只不过这一次被设计成了一款近战动作游戏，而不是一款依靠物理机制驱动的第三人称射击游戏。就目前来看，这种组合非常有效。」
《控制：共振》数字版将于9月24日登陆PC、PS5和XBOX Series，实体版则延期至10月15日发售。

title: 《辐射4》发布新补丁，修复Steam Deck崩溃问题
text:
还更新了Creation Kit
贝塞斯达现已为《辐射4》推出新补丁，更新了Creation Kit，并修复了多项崩溃和Bug问题。
这款已经发售11年的开放世界末日题材RPG现已上线最新更新。Bethesda在Steam公布的补丁说明中表示，本次更新将BA2档案数量上限从256提高至1024，以便更好地支持规模更大的Mod合集。
与此同时，XBOX平台现在可以上传最大2GB的Creations内容。
在崩溃问题方面，贝塞斯达表示，本次更新修复了玩家在Steam Deck设备上打开虚拟键盘时可能导致游戏崩溃的问题，这将改善Valve掌机玩家的使用体验。
贝塞斯达此前曾提醒《辐射4》玩家，在今天的更新上线之前先登录游戏并保存自己的Mod加载顺序。完成保存后，等更新正式上线，玩家就可以一次性重新下载整个Creations列表。
贝塞斯达还表示，目前也正在开发《上古卷轴5：天际》的更新，具体细节将在不久后公布。
你可以在贝塞斯达的 官方网站 查看本次更新的详细内容。

title: 顽皮狗前开发者爆料《神秘海域》初代动态难度为拖慢玩家
text:
如果你觉得游戏突然变难了，那不是你的问题
前顽皮狗开发者透露，《神秘海域：德雷克的宝藏》实际上采用了动态难度系统，其中一个目的就是在玩家表现太好时主动提高难度，从而拖慢推进速度、延长整体游戏时间。
在接受FRVR采访时，前顽皮狗设计师Benson Russell谈到了《神秘海域：德雷克的宝藏》当年颇为困难且复杂的开发过程。
例如，他提到开发团队在设计场景时，一开始并没有充分考虑战斗究竟要如何在这些环境中展开，之后只能再想办法让现有场景适配战斗。
不过，真正最大的问题出现在所有内容基本成型之后：游戏实在太短了。Russell开玩笑表示，他们不可能拿一款只有5小时流程、又没有多人模式的游戏卖60美元。
于是，团队想出了一个办法：动态难度。《神秘海域：德雷克的宝藏》的难度会根据玩家表现进行调整，而其中一个重要目的，就是在玩家推进过快时把他们拖慢，从而延长实际游玩时间。
Russell表示：「我们最后加入了一个动态难度系统，但它最关键的一点，就是如果玩家表现得太好，就把他们拖慢。这是一个很重要的设计，也是为什么《神秘海域1》有时候会突然变得特别难。如果你在当前选择的难度下表现得非常好——这一切其实都是根据时间来判断的！」
Russell解释称，团队当时进行了大量焦点测试，并统计每场战斗遭遇的平均完成时间。我们会做很多焦点测试，然后记录每场战斗遭遇的平均完成时间……如果你完成一场战斗的速度比我们统计出的平均时间更快，我们就会开始把难度往上调。」
动态难度系统后来也被沿用到了最初的《神秘海域》三部曲中。不过在后两部作品里，这套系统经过了更谨慎的调整，主要用于匹配玩家本身的技术水平，而不是像第一部那样直接用来控制游戏节奏。
所以，如果你当年玩《神秘海域：德雷克的宝藏》时曾经感觉游戏难度突然大幅上升，那并不是错觉。简单来说，顽皮狗只是判断你玩得太快，于是主动在前面增加了一些障碍，让你慢下来。
Russell最近还谈到了自己为何对初代《神秘海域》重制版没有兴趣。他认为，这些游戏放到今天依然基本经得起时间考验，而真正进行重制，就意味着顽皮狗必须做出大量调整，这反而可能改变玩家原本喜欢的部分。
至于初代《神秘海域》未来是否真的会推出重制版，目前仍无法确定。不过考虑到近年来越来越多工作室重新挖掘旧作并推出新版，这种可能性也并不令人意外。

title: 《GTA6》疑似再遭重大泄露，黑客组织威胁Rockstar
text:
别的游戏公司也不安全
《GTA6》似乎再次遭遇重大泄露，看起来像是真实实机的视频以及一张完整地图图片已经在网上出现。Rockstar目前尚未对此发表评论。
目前网上出现了两段疑似《GTA6》实机视频：其中一段展示主角杰森在家门外打篮球，另一段则展示杰森驾车并攻击一名NPC。此外，一张据称是游戏完整地图的图片也已经流出。
目前尚不清楚这些素材究竟是如何出现的，也无法确认它们来自哪个开发阶段，但所有内容都指向一种加密货币以及一个网站。据报道，两者均属于一个名为「CyberLeek」的组织。
该网站向Rockstar Games以及其他游戏发行商提出了三项要求，看起来是在针对游戏行业可能走向全数字化的未来表达不满，其中包括数字版预购、「虚假的」单人DLC，以及玩家已经付费购买的单人内容后来被移除等问题。
这份宣言还批评了《GTA6》缺少实体光盘版，同时提到了《飙酷车神》。后者曾成为「Stop Killing Games」消费者运动的核心案例之一，因为Ubisoft最终让这款游戏彻底无法游玩，即使是已经购买游戏的消费者也不例外。
CyberLeek随后还对其他游戏发行商发出威胁，暗示可能会像此次《GTA6》事件一样，通过泄露实机内容等方式针对其他公司。
宣言最后写道：「发行商最好小心。如果CyberLeek连Rockstar都能碰到，那就没人是安全的。这是给所有大公司的一个警告：规矩点，否则下一个目标就是你。」
目前，这些实机视频和地图图片的真实性仍未得到确认，不过Rockstar及其母公司Take-Two似乎正在尝试删除社交媒体平台上的相关视频。
与此同时，这些泄露素材所宣传的迷因币也因此获得了大量关注，不过网络上已经有人担心，这可能是一场加密货币骗局。
IGN已经联系Rockstar和Take-Two寻求回应。如果此次泄露确实属实，那么时间点也非常接近《GTA6》加长版预览先导预告的正式公开。这段内容将作为Netflix限时独占上线，并在Netflix独占6小时后，才会登陆其他平台。
多年来，《GTA6》已经遭遇过多次泄露。2022年，黑客曾将《GTA6》早期版本的90多段视频和图片泄露到网上，成为游戏行业规模最大的安全泄露事件之一。
Take-Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick当时回应称：「我们确实非常严肃地看待泄密，这让我们所有人都非常失望。对团队来说，这真的既令人沮丧又令人难过。」
负责此次事件的英国少年近期已经从安全医院的无限期拘留中获释，目前正在等待重新审判。2023年12月，《GTA6》首支预告原定公开前不到24小时，就提前在X上遭到泄露，迫使Rockstar提前在YouTube正式发布预告。
多名Rockstar开发者随后也在社交媒体上表达了对泄密事件的不满。Zelnick之后将此事称为「令人失望」。他表示：「就泄密本身来说，这对团队而言总是令人失望的事情。但最终，我不认为它对我们造成了伤害。」
今年4月，Rockstar还确认，公司部分信息曾在一起第三方数据泄露事件中遭到访问，不过公司强调，这起事件「没有对我们的组织或玩家造成任何影响」。
《GTA6》目前定于2026年11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series。

title: 官方误发《使命召唤：现代战争4》占位图，玩家疑为AI生成
text:
扭曲的枪
《使命召唤》官方社交媒体团队误发了一张《现代战争4》的内部营销图片，部分玩家怀疑这张图片可能由AI生成。
今天早些时候，《使命召唤》官方X账号发布了一张士兵朝镜头方向走来的宣传图，同时为游戏即将在Gamescom亮相进行预热。
一些眼尖的玩家很快放大检查图片，并发现士兵手中的枪械似乎出现了不自然的扭曲，因此怀疑这张图片可能使用了生成式AI。
随后，这张图片被官方删除，《使命召唤》团队也表示，图片是误发的。
《使命召唤》官方人员在社交媒体上回应称：「今天早些时候，一张图片被误发到了其中一个《使命召唤》账号上。其中包含一张来自营销风格指南的临时渲染图。这张图片只是占位素材，并非来自游戏实机。我们已经将其删除。」
不过，这一回应并没有平息玩家的讨论。部分玩家开始猜测，动视可能正在使用AI生成营销素材的概念图。对于不少《使命召唤》玩家来说，这种猜测可能并不令人意外，因为动视此前已经承认，会使用AI工具制作《使命召唤》的部分素材。
在游戏的Steam商店页面上，官方也加入了相关说明，确认开发过程中使用了生成式AI工具制作部分游戏内容，其中就包括《使命召唤：黑色行动7》中的一些名片等素材。
2025年11月，《黑色行动7》因使用AI内容引发争议后，Activision曾发布声明回应：「和全球许多公司一样，我们使用包括AI工具在内的多种数字工具，为我们的团队提供支持，帮助他们为玩家打造尽可能优秀的游戏体验。但我们的创作过程仍然由工作室中才华出众的员工主导。」
不过，接近一年过去后，玩家对于动视使用生成式AI的做法依然存在不满，一些人甚至对官方所谓「只是占位素材」的解释表示怀疑。
一名玩家讽刺道：「动视？居然会给《使命召唤》用AI垃圾图！？这肯定是哪里搞错了，他们绝对不会这么做的。」另一名玩家则质疑：「开发和美术过程中到底用了多少AI？」
至于本周末即将进行的《现代战争4》Beta测试中，是否会出现明显的AI生成内容，目前还无法确定。即使测试阶段没有发现，等到游戏今年10月正式发售后，玩家显然也会继续留意相关内容。

title: 《仁王 3》DLC“庆安地狱变”制作人访谈：“我还想继续做《仁王》”
text:
新 DLC 讲述竹千代将军的“身后事”
《仁王 3》首个 DLC“庆安地狱变”将于 8 月 19 日正式上线。
标题“庆安”来自“庆安之乱”。庆安初期是主角竹千代（德川家光）刚刚成为将军的时代，但将军死后，大量浪人对幕府的统治深感不满，此时学者由井正雪打算趁着幕府交接之际推翻幕府，夺取政权。竹千代在妖怪的指引下，以梦境形式穿越到自己死后的未来，亲历已化为人间炼狱的江户。
除了新武器“盾矛”和“忍盾矛”外，还追加了名为“百境百怪绘卷”的新机制，玩家可以在独特的模式中战斗，并在获胜后获得该绘卷作为装备；新角色方面，独眼剑豪柳生十兵卫、西班牙使节罗德里戈两人的戏份也令人期待。
在 DLC 正式上线前，我们和国内的几位媒体同行一起，对《仁王 3》制作人柴田刚平进行了一次线上访谈。
《仁王 3》制作人柴田刚平 以下为采访内容整理，为便于阅读，顺序有所调整。
记者：从已公布的 DLC 标题看，你们选了家光在位末期的事件作为舞台。这个选择背后是怎么考虑的？
柴田： 当初决定以“将军”为主题、选德川家康的孙子竹千代当主角时，本篇和 DLC 要讲什么，其实就大致定下来了。本篇是“主角成为将军的故事”，DLC 则是“成为将军之后做了什么的故事”。我们提起历史上真实的将军，往往是从“这个人做了什么”来认识他。只有触及他作为将军的所作所为，以将军为主题的故事才能好好收尾。庆安正是竹千代成为将军、治理天下之后不久的时代，发生在这里的事件，都深受他治世的影响。这一作里，主角穿越时空飞向未来，亲眼看到自己治世下的光明与黑暗。这段经历最后会怎么收束，希望大家能在 DLC1 和 DLC2 里看到结局。
记者：“地狱变”三个字令人想起芥川龙之介的同名小说。这是否意味着 DLC 会围绕一个“为执念不惜自我毁灭”的角色展开？
柴田： “庆安地狱变”这个标题叠了三层意思。第一层，被称为“由井正雪之乱”的“庆安之变”，是在地狱的影响下爆发的。第二层，直白一点说，庆安之世本身变成了地狱。第三层嘛，基本和大家猜的一样 —— 这次异变的核心人物，为了某种执念，不惜把仰慕自己的人卷进来，甚至舍弃自身。大家可以通过游戏里的书信、文书等各种线索，慢慢拼出真相。
（作者注：芥川龙之介《地狱变》讲的是画师良秀为画出地狱屏风，眼睁睁看着独生女在火中焚身的故事。）
芥川龙之介《地狱变》简体中文译本 记者：穿越时空改变历史，难免产生各种矛盾。DLC 会怎么处理主角已经改变历史后产生的新冲突？
柴田： 涉及时间旅行的故事，矛盾确实很难避免。本作里主角穿越到的时代，大家可以理解为是分歧后的另一个世界。之所以要在各个时代破坏狱灵石，是因为它会跨越时空，给主线故事的最终 Boss 供给灵石。所以除了极少数例外，每个时代发生的事并不会影响到其他时代。
记者：西班牙人罗德里戈在这作里的设定，看起来和历史原型出入不小，能展开讲讲吗？
柴田： 罗德里戈的原型，是江户时代初期真正造访过日本的西班牙人，不过我们做了大幅改编。历史上他担任过当时西班牙领地的菲律宾临时总督，有和威廉、德川家康会面的记录。本作里的罗德里戈也当过菲律宾临时总督。在 DLC1 里，他作为西班牙使节来到日本，却卷入了一场变乱，同时他也在追查一个收集发光灵石的同乡女子，怀疑她另有所图。
（作者注：罗德里戈的原型是 1609 年海难漂流至日本的西班牙贵族，曾任菲律宾临时总督，受德川家康接见；威廉是初代主角，原型大家都知道 —— 英国航海家威廉·亚当斯，即三浦按针。）
记者：盾矛是系列里从没出现过的新武器，它的设计思路是怎样的？
柴田： 这次 DLC 里有炼金术师、罗德里戈这些海外势力登场，所以我们想做一种能融入西洋风格的武器。在这个前提下，再想“什么能带来和以往武器完全不同的体验”，最后就选了攻守兼备的“盾矛”。它最大的特点就是“攻防一体”。以往的战斗，是先防御或闪避掉敌人的攻击，再抓破绽反击；而盾矛能在敌人出手的瞬间看准时机弹反，挡下攻击的同时，直接把自己的攻击砸到敌人身上。
记者：盾矛给人的印象偏防御，但《仁王》一向强调高速攻击。Team NINJA 是怎么拿捏这个平衡的？武士和忍者两种风格下，它又分别承担什么定位？
柴田： 盾矛是攻防一体的武器。看准敌人攻击时机弹反，能挡下攻击的同时出手反击。时机判断非常苛刻，但只要敢冒险迎着敌人的攻击冲进去，回报就极大 —— 这是一种高风险高回报、紧张感拉满的武器。
武士的“盾矛”，可以在敌人出手的瞬间使出强力攻击或部分武技，用盾弹开攻击的同时把矛捅进去。无论面对多强的敌人，都能正面硬碰硬地博弈，把对方逼进绝境。
忍者的“忍盾矛”则是另一套打法。除了用盾卸开攻击，还能把盾投出去，或者踩着盾牌和矛的攻击配合，变化多端。也可以借着出招腾空，在空中把盾掷向敌人，纵横驰骋地戏耍对手。
记者：预告片里有一幕是角色把手枪放在腰间快速射击。手枪是盾矛的一种招式吗？还有没有更多用枪的招式？
柴田： 预告片里的射击场面，是新加入的忍术“短筒”。因为远程武器已经有枪和大筒了，所以没有再追加别的用枪技能，但“短筒”最多能连射 6 发，手感完全不同。之前大家对高杉晋作的“短筒”呼声特别高，这次算是不负重望地登场了，请务必试试。
记者：官网提到 2 代的绘卷系统会回归。相比 2 代，这次有什么变化和改良？
柴田： 前作的“百鬼夜行绘卷”里，由敌人和关卡组成的绘卷任务大概只有 100 种模式。这次的“百境百怪绘卷”，任务内容会自动生成，再配合影响战斗的特殊规则，能组合出数亿种不同的战斗。里面既可能生成像奖励任务那样低难度高回报的绘卷，也可能刷出难度极高的绘卷。
它本身是装备在新栏位上的装备品，但每张绘卷设定的任务，得先通关一次才能装备。已经通关的绘卷再打一遍，可以变更它的一项特殊效果，从而自定义性能。挑战次数有限，不过用稀有道具可以增加次数。
另外，这次的“百境百怪绘卷”在神器稀有度会附带“恩宠”，在构筑里的重要性比前作更高了。
记者：《仁王 3》是系列第一次做开放地图，玩家在大地图上花的时间更多，多周目后这点会更明显。以后会不会加单独的选关模式或街机模式，让多周目的刷装更省事？
柴田： 为了让大家能随时方便地挑战任务，神社菜单里准备了“战绘卷”。这次 DLC 里还会追加几个能更高效刷装备的内容。DLC1 的“百境百怪绘卷”就是自动生成的波次战斗，根据生成结果，有时候刷装备的效率会非常高。不过挑战次数有限，建议大家和朋友联机，把彼此的资源都用起来。DLC2 会加入更有挑战性的内容，让战斗和刷装备一起爽，敬请期待。
记者：DLC 的体量相比本篇大概是什么水平？通关一轮要多久？
柴田：规模感和本篇的平安篇相近。“江户·庆安”通关大约 10 到 15 小时，算上新追加的三周目这类深入内容，“庆安地狱变”整体大概能玩 25 到 35 小时。“江户·庆安”的开放地图里，会出现神田、上野这些如今东京还在的地方，还有因地名由来而生的巨大水道桥、分层结构的地下水道网，以及强敌驻守的火山地带等多个区域。作为高难度动作游戏的挑战自不必说，希望大家也能享受丰富多变的场景。
记者：这次的新难度叫“顿悟的旅途”，此前作品中“顿悟”一般到四周目才开放，这次似乎提前到了三周目。为什么这么改？
柴田： 过去我们每出一部 DLC 就加一个难度，这次也一样，只不过本作总共只有两部 DLC，所以比过去少一个。过去追加的三个难度是“修罗”“顿悟”“仁王”，现在要去掉一个，就是砍掉“修罗”。最终难度“仁王”是系列要保留下来的传统，而想要抵达仁王的境界，得先“顿悟”—— 所以顿悟就被提前到了三周目。
记者：忍者模式和开放地图给玩法带来了更多可能，发售后势头也不错。到现在为止，本作在销量和影响力上有没有相应的收获？
柴田： 玩法和攻略方式变宽之后，收到了很多系列老玩家说“玩得开心”的反馈，从《仁王 3》才开始接触系列的新玩家也多了起来。动作层面，“忍者”速度快，是新手也容易上手的风格；开放地图里卡关的时候，也能转去别的区域探索，用另一条路线推进。大家应该也是感受到了“更容易上手”这一点。
记者：《仁王》系列的故事会在这里告一段落吗？未来还有没有续作或衍生作品的计划？站在动作游戏飞速发展的今天，您认为这个系列最不可替代的竞争力是什么？
柴田： 以竹千代为主角的故事，会在 DLC 第二弹暂时画上句号。现在精力都放在 DLC2 的制作上，续作和衍生作品暂时还没有计划。不过就我个人来说，还是想继续把新的《仁王》系列做下去。
《仁王》系列不变的核心竞争力，我觉得是速度极快、爽快感十足的动作，以及它带来的紧张感和成就感，还有丰富多样的攻略方法。
记者：在您看来，动作游戏这个品类未来的核心竞争力是什么？Team NINJA 打算怎么保持自己的领先位置？
柴田： 动作游戏的核心竞争力，动作本身质量高是前提。在这个基础上，能直接刺激爽快感、富有动态的高品质画面表现，以及提升对主角和世界沉浸感的叙事与演出，会越来越被需要。Team NINJA 也会在发挥擅长的速度和响应手感的同时，在这些方面继续下功夫。
记者：本篇里三个时代对应三种属性的地狱 —— 战国篇是火属性的焦热地狱，平安篇是冰属性的八寒地狱，幕末篇是雷属性的针山地狱。官网说 DLC1“庆安地狱变”对应风属性，那 DLC2 是会推出新属性，还是考虑复合属性？
柴田： 很尖锐的问题。《仁王 3》带来了各种以地狱为题材的体验，正在开发中的 DLC2“天草大乱”，我们希望能做出称得上《仁王 3》集大成的体验，请大家期待。
记者：最后聊聊工期。DLC1 原定 9 月底上线，现在 8 月中旬就来了，为此都做了哪些努力？DLC2 会不会也提前一些？
柴田： 我们收到很多已经通关、或正在二周目的玩家的声音，所以一直想尽快把 DLC 端出来。游戏制作有些流程确实省不了时间，不过我们活用本篇的开发经验提高效率、减少了反复试错，才得以提前发售。最后靠的还是干劲和毅力……！DLC2 的具体日期还没定，但同样在全力制作，希望能让大家尽早玩到。
本文由 IGN 中国原创撰写，原作者 Zacky Zhang，未经授权禁止转载。

title: 《仁王3》「庆安地狱变」DLC发售宣传视频
text: 就任将军的主角竹千代，某日在梦中遇见一神秘妖怪，并被引导穿越时空，来到未来的江户——那是一个竹千代死后、和平早已崩坏的世界，昔日繁华的江户化作人间炼狱。在独眼剑豪柳生十兵卫与西班牙使节罗德里戈协助下，竹千代将遭遇对幕府怀恨在心的敌人，并卷入一场围绕灵石展开的全新阴谋。《仁王3》「庆安地狱变」DLC现已登陆PS5及PC平台。

title: 《漫威金刚狼》上手前瞻
text: 《漫威金刚狼》的这次试玩给我留下了不错的印象，但谈不上惊艳。目前游戏在剧情上还有不少底牌没亮出来，而这恰恰是目前最吸引我的地方。战斗系统毫无疑问精准抓住了金刚狼的神韵，底层框架也相当坚实，但它能否经受住整个剧情流程的检验，依然需要打上一个小小的问号。

title: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》多人模式预告
text: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》多人模式提供基于流畅移动的扎实而精确的战斗。在发售当天，玩家将在12张全新的6v6地图中部署，这些地图位于世界各地。此外，大型地图将载具和步兵战斗带到战役中的冲突地点。从紧张的近距离战斗到开放的战场交战，多人游戏的设计旨在让每场战斗都快速、战术性强且充满竞争力。游戏将于10月23日登陆PS5、XBOX Series、Switch 2及PC平台。

title: NOVA海外独立游戏见闻 Vol.148
text:
Vol.148（8 月第 3 周）
本期见闻覆盖时间：8 月 10 日至 8 月 16 日
本期整理： CoryluS
行业见闻录
2027 年 IGF 独立游戏节参展与评审规则公布
8 月 10 日， IGF 独立游戏节（IGF）官方网站 公布了 2027 年度的游戏参展指南与评审规则。作为鼓励游戏开发创新、表彰全球最佳独立开发者的年度盛会，2027 年度 IGF 独立游戏节将于 2027 年 3 月 2 日至 4 日在美国旧金山举办的 GDC 游戏节期间设立专属展区，并定于 3 月 3 日举行颁奖典礼。参展申请已于 8 月上旬开启，提交截止日期为 9 月 13 日，面向全球独立游戏开发者开放。为了维护比赛的独立精神，每家发行商最多只能提交三款游戏，但开发者自己报名不受数量限制。开发者可以提交已经面向大众发布的作品，也可以提交仍处于演示阶段的早期版本——前提是游戏必须具有相对完整的功能。随后，游戏节会邀请数百名游戏开发者、教育工作者和媒体人组成的初始评审团，在三到五周内进行随机体验并做出推荐。最后，除了由公众投票决定的观众奖之外，其他各个奖项的获胜者都将在入围名单公布后，由各组评委进行第二轮投票并在颁奖典礼上公布，而 Seumas McNally 大奖则由所有评委共同审阅各类别游戏后最终投票产生。
图片： igf.com
2027 年 BAFTA 游戏奖开放报名及规则更新
8 月 12 日， 英国电影和电视艺术学院（BAFTA）官方网站 报道，备受游戏行业瞩目的 2027 年 BAFTA 游戏大奖已正式开放作品报名通道，并同时更新了赛事的投票要求、报名费用结构和人工智能政策等多项重要规则。该奖项每年颁发一次，核心目的是为了表彰和奖励个人在构思、塑造和实现最终艺术成果方面所取得的“杰出人类成就”——无论创作者使用何种工具来完成这些作品。作为最终裁决方，BAFTA 保留了要求参赛方提交额外证明材料的权利，用以核查人类创造力与实际开发过程。
据 媒体 GamesIndustry.biz 报道 ，今年 BAFTA 游戏大奖的费用结构迎来了多项变革：官方取消了以往 50%的“早期报名或发行首月折扣”，改为向符合条件的小型团队与独立开发者提供 25%的专属优惠；同时，赛事新设了“基础报名费”，单次支付即可涵盖最多四个自选类别，并在满足条件时免费附送最佳游戏、最佳英国游戏、主角表演及配角表演等核心奖项的参评资格。提名与最终奖项将由包含逾一千七百名专业人士在内的 BAFTA 会员共同裁决，确保奖项能真实反映当下的市场格局与玩家动态。
2027 年 BAFTA 游戏大奖颁奖典礼已确认将于 2027 年 4 月 14 日在英国伦敦举行，参评窗口为 2025 年 11 月 15 日至 2026 年 11 月 19 日期间发行的游戏。该奖项的初步入围长名单将于 2026 年 12 月 8 日公布，最终提名名单暂定于 2027 年 3 月 11 日揭晓。
图片： www.bafta.org
前育碧员工成立独立工作室 Dark Ritual
8 月 11 日，据 媒体 GamesIndustry.biz 报道 ，前育碧巴塞罗那工作室的一批员工正式成立了一家名为 Dark Ritual Studios 的独立游戏工作室。该团队将总部设在巴塞罗那，并致力于打造名为《Puzzle Mage》的俯视角点击动作冒险游戏。
工作室负责人 Myles Kerwin 表示，在像育碧这样的大型组织中的工作经历，让他们深刻体会到了保持敏捷性是多么困难的，也让他们强化了长久以来的一个理念——即伟大的游戏并不一定需要庞大的开发团队。Myles 坦言目前的 3A 级别游戏开发已经变得异常复杂，大型项目不可避免地需要涉及多个层面的协调工作，而这往往会严重拖慢创造性的决策过程。因此，Dark Ritual Studios 决定采取与大型 3A 开发完全相反的路线，确保游戏创意能够迅速从讨论阶段落实到具体的实现环节。
报道还称，新作《Puzzle Mage》目前已经成功获得了完成开发所需的资金支持，并且在 Steam 平台上的愿望单数量迅速突破了一千。
图片： gamesindustry.biz
《Big Walk》发售六天销量破百万
8 月 11 日，据游戏发行商 Panic 在 社交平台 Bluesky 的官方账号发帖 称，由澳大利亚独立游戏开发工作室 House House 制作、Panic 发行的多人合作冒险解谜游戏《Big Walk》在发售后短短六天内便售出了 100 万份。作为业内知名开发团队，House House 此前曾凭借广受赞誉的热门独立游戏《捣蛋鹅》而声名大噪。这款主打“交流与步行”的开放世界新作不仅继承了工作室一贯的优秀设计，其取得百万销量里程碑的速度更是远超前作——《捣蛋鹅》在当年曾花费三个月才达成 100 万销量。据 媒体 PC Gamer 进一步分析 ，为了更直观地展现《Big Walk》的商业成功，可以将其与今年的其他热门独立游戏进行对比：《挖掘者米娜》在十一天内售出 50 万份；《Meccha Chameleon》在四天内售出 100 万份；《Mewgenics》耗时八天达成 100 万销量。
图片： bsky.app
印度游戏市场 2026 年底预计将达 12 亿美元
8 月 14 日， 据媒体 GamesIndustry.biz 援引 数据分析公司 Niko Partners 发布的关于 印度游戏市场的最新预测报告 称，印度游戏市场的总收入将于 2026 年底达到近 12 亿美元，而到了 2030 年，这一数字有望进一步飙升至 17.7 亿美元，实现高达 11.2%的 5 年复合年增长率。报告还显示，印度玩家总数在去年达到了 5.11 亿人，报告预测 2026 年底印度玩家总数将超过 5.5 亿，并在 2030 年突破 7 亿人大关；与此同时，目前女性玩家已经占到了印度玩家总数的近一半，较 2023 年 43%的比例有了显著提升。此外，印度的游戏市场正变得愈发多元化，玩家受众群体开始向移动端之外的电脑和主机等平台扩展，并探索更为广泛的游戏类型。
图片： nikopartners.com
独游公告板
一周拾遗 ：本周值得关注的新发售、重新上架或公布新版本的独立游戏。
1. 8 月 10 日，此前在 Itch.io 平台上爆火的解谜游戏《Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse》正式登陆 Steam 平台。玩家需要使用各种具有不同效果的镜片调整马匹的身形，使其与目标马匹的样子完全匹配。在发售后短短几天内，《Horse Magnifier》就已经收获了超过 250 条“特别好评”的用户评价，足以证明其在玩家群体中受欢迎的程度。截至 16 日，游戏在 Steam 上已经积累了 669 条用户评价，好评率高达 99%。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4585340/Horse_Magnifier_The_Full_Horse/
2. 8 月 11 日，由开发商 Aggro Crab 和发行商 Landfall Games 组成的 Team PEAK 所打造的合作攀岩独立游戏《PEAK》正式迎来了名为“最终攀登”的最后一次重大更新：新增两个后期变体生物群落“Gloom”和“The Citadel”，加入获得各种古怪道具的“小丑行李箱”，增添滑翔翼等全新装备，以及十个新徽章和配套的装饰品供玩家解锁。开发团队在公告中详细说明了为何这是《PEAK》的最后一次重大更新：团队在更新内容方面所投入的精力已经远远超出了预期，他们不希望《PEAK》变成一款为了吸引注意力而不断添加新东西从而导致体验臃肿的游戏。
https://www.eurogamer.net/peak-final-major-update
3. 8 月 13 日，由独立游戏开发商与发行商 Hesperus Games 制作的短篇非线性侦探解谜游戏《诈欺谜案》现已提供简体中文版本，涵盖了游戏内基础内容的翻译以及所有带有内嵌文本的证据文件。玩家需要仔细阅读并交叉比对各类文件，抽丝剥茧，查明 CEO 失踪的真相，将一桩诈欺谜案公之于众。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3036350/A_Case_of_Fraud/
开发追踪： 本周更新开发关键节点、尚处在开发早期或中期的独立游戏。
1. 8 月 15 日，由独立游戏开发商 Rapturous Studio 制作、2 Left Thumbs 发行的赛博朋克风格角色扮演游戏《Robot Rhapsody》在众筹平台 Kickstarter 发起的项目圆满结束，截至募资成功时刻，该项目已经累计获得了 58237 美元的认缴金额，并吸引了多达 1474 名支持者的热情参与。Rapturous Studio 此前因发行过曾荣获 2026 年 RPGMaker 的最佳角色扮演游戏大奖的作品 《Beloved Rapture》 而大受好评——这也为新作的众筹项目助力良多。《Robot Rhapsody》是一部关于科技邪教、叛军以及机器人吟游诗人的角色扮演回合制战斗游戏，深入探讨了人工智能、反乌托邦、环保主义以及艺术反抗等现代社会话题。
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rapturousstudio/robot-rhapsody/description
Demo 体验： 本周上线 Demo、或可一试的独立游戏一览。
1.《Chesstris》
关键字：解谜、回合制、策略；国际象棋与俄罗斯方块相遇，带来一系列手工打造的谜题。放下棋子，将敌方国王逼入绝境，同时避免将死己方国王。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5014090
2.《Light Source》
关键字：角色扮演、冒险、类魂系列；跟随 Bulb，在这个黑暗的 2D 回合制 RPG 中，为黯淡的卢梅里亚王国重新带来光明。帮助当地居民，在不断升级的艰难战斗中杀出重围，揭开隐藏在这个衰败王国深处的秘密。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4989280
3.《Get Stoned》
关键字：塔防、策略、俯视射击；在保卫城堡的过程中收集资源、解锁独特的巨石，并发现颠覆平衡的协同效果。是时候让一切“石”化起来了！
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4669050
4.《Patsy's Retirement》
关键字：桌面伴侣、挂机游戏、女性主角；帕齐刚刚退休，她要在你桌面上的一座小岛上享受退休生活。在你工作的时候，看着她按自己悠闲的节奏浇花、喂鸭子、扫落叶。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4879360
5.《徘徊之碑 - Lingering Stele》
关键字：氛围、角色扮演、情感；这里是结束了所有纷争后的和平世界，过去没能解明的那些话语，在此处是否还有弥补的机会？
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5007800
6.《Golden Retriever Simple Life》
关键字：狗、休闲、生活模拟；与可爱的金毛寻回犬皮丘一起度过每一天。探索新的散步地点，训练它、陪它玩耍，并在朝夕相处中不断加深你们之间的羁绊。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4824970
7.《The Money Man》
关键字：选择取向、指向点击、反乌托邦；一个世纪前，富豪们纷纷逃往火星。地球正在腐烂，而黑帮掌控着纽约。如今你心爱之人命悬一线，你绝不能有任何差错。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4705010
8.《SKEW》
关键字：模拟、步行模拟、探索；一款以阈限空间与梦核氛围为核心的第一人称探索游戏，没有怪物、战斗或“跳脸杀”。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4991500
9.《Marketfield Idle》
关键字：模拟、策略、沙盒；种植作物、出售商品、烹饪食谱、自动化生产，并通过声望系统开启更强的轮回。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4860280
10.《Guns & Gargoyles》
关键字：迷宫探索、类魂系列、俯视射击；你只能看到光线触及之处。掷出飞刀再从尸体上拔回，用燃烧弹焚毁狼群，等它们逼近时挥剑迎战。没有枪械，只有你能随身携带的武器，以及尽头等待着的一头野兽。

11.《Travelling At Night》
关键字：选择取向、指向点击、角色扮演；显形。告解。消失。化身驱灵师、魔术师或者——惨一些——码字的人，走进这个世界，环球旅行。置身迥异于现实的 1940 年代欧洲，选择你的历史。

title: 本周 Steam 值得关注的游戏 08.17 - 08.23（三）
text:
第二部分
注： 本系列文章的信息主要整合自 Steam 与 SteamDB 的即将发售列表，由于 Steam 支持手动输入日期及发售、同步不及时等原因，本列表可能会遗漏收录一些作品的发售信息。如果本周有您的作品或您喜欢的作品未被列出，欢迎直接评论补充链接～～
TIC-TAC: Twelve o'clock
关键字： 生存恐怖、探索、冒险
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
《TIC-TAC: Twelve o'clock》是一款生存恐怖游戏。通过监控摄像头监视走廊和房间，对抗复仇的幽灵。保持灯光开启，发电机充电，并更换保险丝……最重要的是，不要被抓住！
放置领主：财富之城（Hearth and Hamlet）
关键字： 增量、城市营造、管理
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
收集资源，轻松规划，自动运转，持续成长，建立属于你的财富之城。从一处篝火营地开始，分配工人，扩大领地，与其他城邦进行贸易，不断解锁新的建筑、技术、政策，甚至神秘魔法，逐渐发展为大陆上最强大的王国。
Desktop Detective
关键字： 桌面伴侣、挂机游戏、调查
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
一款放置侦探游戏，会在你做其他事情时待在屏幕一角运行。
Drive Me Broke
关键字： 汽车模拟、驾驶、生存
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
努力生存 🏚️，积累声望 ✊，赚取金钱 💸，改装爱车 🛠️，赢得比赛 🏁，成为传奇 👑
绍宋: 还我河山（Shao Song I）
关键字： 全动态影像、互动小说、历史
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
这是一款沉浸式真人互动历史权谋影视游戏！你将化身赵玖，魂穿南宋最具争议的皇帝赵构，每次抉择都将左右王朝气运、定夺天下兴亡！面对靖康之变后的山河破碎，你能否打破宿命再造山河？真人互动影视游戏《绍宋：还我河山》邀你于乱世绝境之中，一起喊出宋可亡，天下不可亡的怒吼！
HYPER PRIMATE
关键字： 快节奏、跑酷、第一人称射击、竞分
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
一款高速移动为主的第一人称射击游戏，你将化身一只超高速猿猴，尽情制造混乱。利用海量武器库，冲刺、抓钩、轰穿致命的障碍赛道。掌控动量，险中求生，完美通关，最终制霸排行榜！
弹企鹅（PengPong）
关键字： 弹幕射击、动作类 Rogue
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
《弹企鹅 PengPong》 是一款弹幕射击 Roguelike 游戏。只不过，我们又往里加了点物理弹射的佐料以及需要一点运气点缀的……变数。
少女死神养成计划（Grim Trials）
关键字： 动作类 Rogue、砍杀、角色扮演
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
证明你的价值，在这场成为死神的试炼中披荆斩棘、突破重围！探索死后世界的“学院”，一座培养死神候选人的训练场。结识志同道合的死神伙伴，向导师学习战斗之道，重拾生前失落的爱与真相。
度假咖啡厅模拟器（Vacation Cafe Simulator）
关键字： AI 生成内容、烹饪、模拟、合作
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
惬意的意式度假咖啡厅 🏖️ 没有时限・零压力 😌 烹制传统料理 🍝 随心打造升级装潢🏠 畅饮普罗赛克 🥂 放松经营梦想咖啡厅 ✨
幽灵地铁（Spirited Line）
关键字： Boss Rush、动作冒险
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
《Spirited Line》是一款一击必杀的 BOSS 连战砍杀动作游戏。于极简而超现实的地铁中，与独特灵魂展开激烈对决。专注与时机，将决定你能否生存。
加里波利（Gallipoli）
关键字： 模拟、一战、第一人称射击
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
登陆加里波利海滩，50 名玩家在奥斯曼前线争夺目标点，开启大规模鏖斗！扮演历史上的 10 个兵种之一，手持真实武器，亲历一战的堑壕作战与沙漠远征。《Gallipoli》将为你带来迄今为止最沉浸的一战第一人称射击体验。
Deep Blue Sushi
关键字： 钓鱼、冒险、烹饪、管理
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）EA
《Deep Blue Sushi》是一款支持 1–5 人合作游玩的休闲冒险游戏。探索海洋、捕捉新鲜鱼类、制作寿司、服务顾客并经营壮大餐厅，同时揭开神秘 Deep Blue 的秘密。
Sensory Overload
关键字： 奔跑、动作、精确平台、竞分
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
这是一款下落游戏，目标就是压垮你的感官。扭曲的隧道、迷幻的图案、仿佛在呼吸的洞壁，不断冲击你的平衡感，混乱也会一关一关不断增加。
Drunken Rogue
关键字： 角色扮演、牌组构建、卡牌游戏
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
嗜酒成性的盗贼·莉塔与末日吸血鬼·恩度的欢脱大冒险！你能够在陷阱与怪物的袭击下潜入迷宫最深层，得到令人垂涎的极品美酒吗？
Ironsand
关键字： 在线合作、第一人称射击、轻度 Rogue
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
《Ironsand》是一款合作泰坦狩猎 FPS roguelite 游戏，背景设定在一个沙漠星球上，强大的装备和团队协作至关重要！
Sudoku Mansion
关键字： 解谜、逻辑、类银河战士恶魔城
发行日期： 2026/08/20（暂无中文）
这是一款由谜题设计师 Nurator 创作，在《Cracking the Cryptic》上推出的剧情向数独冒险游戏。探索这座充满手工制作的数独变体谜题的神秘庄园，攻克难度逐渐增加的谜题，并揭开网格背后隐藏的秘密。
一笔勾销（NEVER HAPPENED）
关键字： AI 生成内容、设计与插画、欢乐、竞分
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
“没被发现，就是艺术史。”——画家梦碎，如今你靠运送名画糊口。公司只有一条规矩：绝不能留下一道划痕。可手总会滑——而这家公司有个代代相传的“老规矩”：补上去，就当没发生过。验收官到来前的三分钟，用你自己的画笔盖住破损。收录名画 100 幅，全是真迹。每日挑战与最多 4 人对战，与全世界比手艺。
Vice Signalling
关键字： 免费开玩、叙事、短篇
发行日期： 2026/08/20（暂无中文）
《Vice Signalling》是一款短篇叙事游戏，你将潜入一个由权贵组成的秘密组织。破译秘密信号，并利用它们揭露针对皇帝的阴谋。
Eggventure
关键字： 类银河战士恶魔城、动作冒险
发行日期： 2026/08/20（暂无中文）
《Eggventure》是一款 2D 银河城平台游戏，玩家将扮演埃格伯特——一颗鸡蛋，他的任务是拯救朋友们，不让他们沦为早餐。
File Tower Defence
关键字： 塔防、轻度 Rogue
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
抵御入侵桌面的病毒！这是一款以操作系统为主题的策略塔防游戏，结合各种文件扩展名来构建强大的防御塔吧。
Runic Curse Remastered
关键字： 动作、冒险、类银河战士恶魔城
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
《符文诅咒：重制版》是一款激动人心的类银河战士恶魔城动作角色扮演游戏，将带你前往一座被诅咒的岛屿。探索黑暗多变的地点，与成群的敌人和强大的首领战斗。结合各种武器与魔法符文，打造属于你自己的游戏风格，克服所有考验。
Left Not Right
关键字： 精确平台
发行日期： 2026/08/20（ 中文支持 ）
左手操作左边，右手操作右边，可同时进行! 这是不需要朋友的单机游戏，可放心进行。 可用双手同时移动两个角色，试图完成逃离地下研究室。
第四部分
下一部分明日送上！

title: 新游上线只是开始，中国PC主机游戏正在Twitch上重做海外营销
text:
今年 ChinaJoy 逛下来，罗斯基发现国内厂商讨论 PC 与主机出海时，话题具体了很多。
前几年，行业关心的是中国团队能不能做出面向全球市场的产品。随着《黑神话：悟空》《鸣潮》《明日方舟：终末地》等游戏陆续上线，这个问题已经有了答案。
如今大家更头疼的是另一件事——产品做出来了，怎么让海外玩家看见、理解，最后愿意买单？
宏观看，市场机会仍然可观。
Sensor Tower 数据显示，2025 年全球游戏产业规模接近 2000 亿美元，其中 PC 与主机游戏贡献约 950 亿美元（约合 6412 亿人民币）。Steam 全球收入也从 2022 年的 78 亿美元增长至 2025 年约 110 亿美元，3 年累计增幅达到 41%。
图源：Sensor Tower
但钱并没有平均分给每款游戏。
Newzoo 的报告显示，西方主机市场近三分之二的收入集中在头部 20 款产品。虽然 PC 市场相对分散，但玩家注意力在向热门作品和成熟发行商聚集。上架渠道越来越成熟，“被发现”反而成了更难的一关。
不同产品面对的又是不同考题。
买断制大作需要在首发窗口集中声量，将认知和愿望单转化为销量；长线服务型游戏更看重版本更新、玩家回流和社区活跃；预算有限的独立游戏，则适合从垂直社区切入，通过中腰部创作者、Demo 和真实试玩找到第一批玩家。
这也意味着，不同产品很难套用同一份出海方案。
ChinaJoy 期间，亚马逊广告与 Twitch 联合举办 HypeLounge 2026 游戏品牌出海交流之夜。作为全球直播领域的头部平台之一，Twitch 平均每月吸引超 1.05 亿观众，平均月活主播超 500 万人，是全球玩家群体的核心聚集地。
结合现场分享及最新的出海游戏全域营销方案，罗斯基看到了一条明确的变化：海外发行正在从上线前后的集中投放，转向贯穿预热、首发、版本更新与社区经营的长期工作，而创作者和玩家社区正成为其中的重要连接点。
·不同品类的游戏，为什么都选择让玩家“入戏”？
具体到落地层面，《明日方舟：终末地》与《使命召唤：黑色行动 6》代表了两种完全不同的业务场景。
前者是鹰角网络旗下 Gryphline 推出的跨平台 3D 策略 RPG。虽然背靠《明日方舟》IP，但玩法形态、世界舞台和视觉表现都有明显变化。公测期间，团队既要向老玩家解释新作，也要让不了解原作的海外 PC 主机用户迅速进入设定。
后者则是一个运营超过 20 年的全球级 IP。玩家早已熟悉品牌和射击玩法，它面对的问题是如何在系列新品不断推出的情况下，再制造一次足够新鲜的发布事件。
一个要降低新世界观的理解门槛，一个要为成熟 IP 找回惊喜感。两个项目最后没有把 Twitch 当成普通投放渠道，而是直接把直播间变成了游戏体验的一部分。
《明日方舟：终末地》公测期间，Gryphline 与 Twitch 围绕游戏中的敌对存在 Aggeloi，策划了一场跨直播间的“入侵事件”。
Aggeloi 会突然进入主播的直播内容，带来即时挑战。主播以游戏“管理员”的身份加入“终末地工业”，再带领自己的社区迎战。观众通过聊天、专属表情和 Boss 挑战参与任务，逐步推动事件发展。
对第一次接触游戏的海外玩家来说，这套过程比集中解释世界观轻松得多。先看到入侵，再跟随主播加入组织，
玩家也就能对游戏的阵营设定和整体氛围形成直观印象。活动最终累计获得 270 万分钟观看时长，近 4000 个 Boss 被击败，专属表情也成了社区内继续传播的话题。
《使命召唤：黑色行动 6》的 “Rogue Shadow Ops” 则把直播做成了一场互动谍战剧。
团队搭建了两个原创 3D 房间，观众需要在聊天室中与主播协作，破解暗号和机关。品牌 Raid 将数千名观众转移至下一位主播，让任务跨越不同直播间继续推进。到了线下“审讯”环节，观众又成了陪审团，能够影响剧情走向。
游戏发售后，聊天室继续为英国和德国战队发布任务。平台方披露，这场活动获得 270 万分钟观看时长，达到基准值的 5.5 倍；独立观众超过 42.3 万，聊天消息超过 10.5 万条。品牌好感度提升 9 个百分点，购买意愿提升 10.1 个百分点。
在罗斯基看来，两个案例的共同点是：主播负责带玩家进入情境，社区负责让内容继续发生。游戏营销保留了游戏本身的参与感，玩家自然也更容易记住它。
图源：动视《使命召唤：黑色行动 6》官方网站活动页面截图
除了营销事件，文化差异也是发行营销中的一大痛点。
同一段剧情，在北美、欧洲、日本玩家眼中可能对应着完全不同的文化经验。仅仅完成语言翻译和素材适配，很难让陌生题材跨过理解门槛。团队需要找到当地玩家熟悉的讲述者，并允许他们用自己的社区语言解释产品。
《黑神话：悟空》的全球传播就是一个典型样本。
游戏科学是海外玩家眼中的新面孔，《西游记》及其背后的东方文化也需要重新解释。项目最终选择与众多编辑及主播建立联系：先提供基础内容，从中筛选理解深入、反馈积极的创作者，再与其中最有热情的一批人共创。
这套去中心化打法最终触发了更大规模的自然内容。《黑神话：悟空》上线 6 天销量超过 1400 万份，Steam 好评率达到 95%，并成为 Twitch 年度观看量最高的单机游戏之一，相关项目还获得了艾菲全球化金奖。
·创作者合作，如何走向规模化管理？
团队要筛选主播、谈合作、确认内容，还要追踪每场直播的实际反馈。跨多个国家推广时，工作量会迅速增加。头部主播适合制造声量，中腰部主播更容易深入垂直人群，但后者数量多，管理成本也更高。
Twitch 近期更新的 Creator Sponsorships，主要就在降低这类协作门槛。
Bounty Board 已通过“公开邀请”模式向合作伙伴主播和联盟主播开放。品牌可以集中发布推广任务，由创作者根据自身内容和受众参与。据 Twitch 官方博客披露，此前《我的世界》的一场活动吸引了超过 6000 名主播，其中一半以上来自联盟主播。
对大体量产品来说，这让“悬赏任务发布 + 中腰部规模铺开”成为可能。独立团队也可以绕开昂贵的全域覆盖，先进入几个契合度高的社区，观察试玩反馈和愿望单变化。
AI 工具，则是帮团队处理筛选和复盘。
Creator Automatching+ 会结合主播过往内容、受众画像和品牌契合度推荐人选；Chat Sentiment Analysis 可以分析直播期间的聊天信息，帮助团队判断不同社区的真实反应；Live Campaign Assist 则用于检查主播是否讲清核心信息，并在内容出现偏差时及时提醒。
这些能力解决的是繁琐的“手工作业”，不会代替主播表达。创作者真正有价值的地方，恰恰是他们知道如何与自己的观众"说话"。
最终，Twitch 一系列平台能力的落脚点，就是跑通一款产品从预热首发到长线运营的全生命周期工作流，实现创作者、玩家社区与产品三者间的深度链接。
·看到主播玩，玩家能不能马上自己试？
直播种草还有一处“常见损耗”。
观众觉得游戏有趣，随后要离开直播间、搜索、下载，兴趣可能在这个过程中逐渐消退。尤其是独立游戏，很多玩法只靠预告片很难讲清楚，玩家亲手操作几分钟，感受反而更直接。
Twitch 推出的 Gameplay Ads，尝试把试玩放进直播场景。
玩家无需提前下载，点击即可体验，也可以与创作者赞助内容结合。目前，该形式已与 THQ Nordic、IO Interactive 等厂商合作，覆盖《REANIMAL》《杀手：暗杀世界》等产品，后续还将从北美拓展至欧洲和亚洲。
Sponsored Shopping 则继续缩短购买路径，让用户无需离开直播即可采取购买行动。主播激发兴趣，试玩验证玩法，购买承接需求，几个环节能够在相近的内容场景中完成。
当然，玩家也不会只在 Twitch 上认识一款游戏。他们可能先在流媒体电视看到预告，再去直播间看实机，之后才访问商店。
亚马逊广告提供的补充价值，在于把不同媒体触点接起来。各个触点也不必做同一件事——大屏内容建立认知，主播试玩解释玩法，社区互动形成口碑，试玩与购物工具承接行动。
借助亚马逊 DSP，厂商可以覆盖 Twitch、Prime Video、Fire TV、Amazon Music 等亚马逊自有媒体，以及 Spotify、Netflix、Disney、Roku 等合作资源。其购物、浏览和流媒体信号，还可以帮助团队识别购买过游戏主机、外设或长期关注同品类内容的人群。
·海外发行，是一场长期接力
从今年 ChinaJoy 释放出的信息看，中国 PC 与主机游戏已经跨过产品阶段，接下来要解决的是如何经营全球玩家。
首发期需要集中声量，长线产品需要稳定社区，版本更新要兼顾拉新与召回，独立游戏则要把有限预算花在最匹配的人群上。创作者、广告、试玩和社区活动各有作用，关键在于根据产品阶段排好顺序，让前一次沟通能为下一步行动铺路。
Twitch 长期积累的是创作者与玩家之间的关系，亚马逊广告补充了跨媒体触达能力。两者拼在一起，是一套围绕游戏生命周期展开的发行工具箱。
罗斯基认为，中国游戏出海的“最后一公里”，归根结底还是玩家愿不愿意接纳一款产品。被看见只是开头，有人愿意试玩和讨论，并在下一次版本更新时回来，产品才算真正进入了当地市场。 返回搜狐，查看更多

title: 一款微信小游戏TOP10背后，芒果互娱正在形成怎样的发行闭环？
text:
最近，微信小游戏榜单上出现了一款颇为眼熟的产品。所谓“眼熟”，指的并非 IP 或画风，而是玩法。
《轻松就通关》是一款典型的脑洞解谜游戏：帮小哥哥长高、让贫困家庭改善生活、给一家人拍出满意的全家福……玩家需要在限定时间内观察场景，拖动物品、寻找线索，试出那个往往不太符合常理的答案。
这类游戏规则直观，素材也好理解，过去两年一直是小游戏市场的热门方向。但在供给密集、同类产品不少的情况下，《轻松就通关》近期排到了微信游戏人气总榜第 14 位，并进入微信小游戏人气榜第 8 位。
对一款没有强 IP 加持的轻度产品来说，这个阶段性成绩非常亮眼。
罗斯基过去持续关注过芒果互娱的游戏业务，之前围绕《向往的生活》等产品写过多篇文章。相比单纯讨论一款小游戏为何上榜，我们更感兴趣的是——过去更常因芒果系 IP 被行业提及的芒果互娱，为什么开始在小游戏发行侧连续跑出产品？
·玩法不新鲜，产品结构却很完整
《轻松就通关》的关卡设计，抓住了脑洞解谜最容易传播的部分。
每关都有一个具体目标，玩家看到题目后，很自然就会产生“答案到底是什么”的好奇。解法通常藏在场景中的人物、道具或文字里，有时需要组合线索，有时则要打破惯性思维。即使没有真正玩过，用户只看几秒广告也能理解关卡冲突。
限时机制又给这种轻度解谜增加了一点紧迫感。时间不够可以观看广告加时，卡关时可以通过广告获得提示，也可以选择直接跳过。广告出现的节点都对应着玩家眼下的需求，和玩法衔接得相对顺畅。
但是，只靠不断换题，仍然很难让玩家长期闯关。
《轻松就通关》因此在关卡之外放入了一条轻量成长线：玩家每次通关都会积累进度，逐步改善一位贫困女性的生活和居住环境。原本彼此独立的脑洞关卡，由此多了一个可以持续追踪的局外长线目标。
这套结构很适合小游戏生态。脑洞关卡方便快速上手，也能持续产出投放素材；局外变化提供继续闯关的理由；提示、跳关和加时承接广告变现。几个环节互相咬合，商业模型也更容易被验证。
产品的底子，决定了一款游戏有没有放量的可能。但榜单上的最终位置，还要看发行团队能不能把这种可能变成结果。
·小游戏发行，最怕把“跑量”误当成能力
外界看小游戏发行，容易把过程简化成投流和冲榜。实际做过的人都知道，预算只是放大器。
素材能带来点击，用户进入游戏后却很快流失，量越大，亏损也越快；某组广告看起来获客便宜，后续广告观看和留存表现不佳，同样没有持续投入的空间。发行团队每天面对的，其实是一连串取舍——哪类关卡更适合做素材，什么样的人群更愿意留下，什么时候可以加量，数据出现波动后又该怎样调整。
据芒果互娱披露，《轻松就通关》的发行也经历了一个从测试到放量的过程。
项目先以较小规模测试素材和用户反馈，观察玩家进入游戏后的闯关、留存及广告变现表现。确认整体模型能够成立后，团队才逐步增加投放，排名也随之上升。
这个过程听起来是小游戏发行的常规操作，难点恰恰在“常规”二字。测试期太短，可能把偶然数据当成趋势；过早放量，成本和用户质量容易失控；过度追求低成本，又可能错过后续价值更高的人群。
因此，《轻松就通关》进入微信小游戏人气榜 TOP 10，至少说明产品和发行节奏在当前阶段形成了配合。榜单提供了一个容易被看见的结果，背后真正得到验证的，则是从选品、测试到放量的一整套执行。
·一次合作，还是一套持续运转的关系？
《轻松就通关》由北京泰格参与研发发行。
泰格此前已经积累了小游戏产品经验，也是第二届“马栏山杯”小游戏大赛获奖产品背后的团队。芒果互娱与泰格双方此前已在 IP 授权、产品研发和发行等方向展开合作，《轻松就通关》可以视为这段合作关系中的最新结果。
这种合作方式在小游戏市场中越来越重要。
轻度产品迭代很快，研发团队熟悉内容生产、调优和版本节奏，发行团队则更接近渠道及不同用户群体。双方如果只做一次交易，项目结束后，测试中积累的经验也很容易随之中断。长期协作能够让发行反馈更快进入研发，上一款产品踩过的坑，也可以成为下一次选品和调优的参考。
在《轻松就通关》这个项目中，泰格提供了产品基础和小游戏研发经验，芒果互娱则参与产品判断、商业化验证和投流发行。产品能够上榜，是双方能力共同作用的结果。
罗斯基认为，这种关系比“谁发行了一款榜单产品”更值得关注。小游戏很难依赖一款产品吃很多年，真正有用的积累，是找到稳定的合作团队，并在一次次测试中逐渐提高产品跑通的概率。
·芒果互娱，正在补上 IP 之外的另一面
过去，行业对芒果互娱游戏业务的印象，更多来自内容资源和芒果系 IP。
相关内容推进：从小游戏到互动影游，芒果TV打开游戏生态新想象
背靠成熟的影视、综艺和艺人内容生态，IP 一直是芒果互娱最容易被外界感知的优势。但 IP 授权解决的主要是内容和用户认知问题，一款游戏能否推向市场，还涉及产品供给、商业化测试和渠道发行。
典型案例比如《向往的生活》：
这次《轻松就通关》没有借助强势 IP，反而让芒果互娱游戏业务的另一面变得清晰了一些。
从寻找合适的 CP 和产品，到参与测试、判断模型，再到投流与渠道发行，芒果互娱正将原本以 IP 为起点的合作，向更完整的发行链路延伸。它与泰格的多线合作，也说明公司希望和 CP 共同开发一门长期生意，而非只完成一次授权或代理。
《轻松就通关》是当下一块较为显眼的拼图，结合芒果互娱近期陆续跑通商业模型的其他产品来看，其选品和发行能力正在逐步成形。
这也可能改变行业 CP 对芒果互娱的判断。
手里有合适的产品，可以谈测试和发行；拥有研发能力，可以讨论更早期的产品协同；需要内容资源，也还有 IP 合作的空间。双方可谈的内容比过去更多，合作周期也有机会变得更长。
对芒果互娱而言，比单品成绩更重要的变化或许是——它开始具备把产品挑出来、做验证，再和合作伙伴一起推向市场的能力。 返回搜狐，查看更多

title: Arc Raiders' map conditions 'will shift to fit specific regions' peak hours' as part of the latest Phantom Targets update
text:
I love a good Arc Raiders map condition. Whether it be hunting for rubber ducks in Bird City, or trying to survive frozen temperatures in Cold Snap, each one offers up a much-needed revamp on what can sometimes be a stale selection of maps. The only problem is that some conditions can be pretty inaccessible.
Initially map conditions followed the same global release for everyone. This wasn't much of an issue when the game released t as there were only a handful of conditions to tack onto maps, but as more appeared it's become increasingly difficult to play some of them. Take Bird City for example—I love it, but when it first released it was almost impossible to play because it was only live when I was at work (boo) or sleeping (yay).
(Image credit: Embark) Embark tried to fix this by upping the frequency of said map conditions but this only worked so well, with there still being regions which would see less of certain conditions compared to others. Luckily, it seems like this is all behind us now as Embark has pushed out a solution in its latest update which means fairer map condition distributions for all.
"We have been working to make sure that the way we schedule map conditions is aligned with your playing habits," Embark says in the new update blog post . "To that end, we’re introducing Regional Map Condition Scheduling. Starting with 1.42.0, map conditions will have their schedule offset based on regions, instead of a single, global schedule.
"This means that the schedule will shift to fit specific regions' peak hours to better match your experience. This way, it’ll be less likely to miss out on a map condition regardless of where you are."
You can check out the new schedule for yourself using the map conditions tracker . And as you'll be able to see, there's masses of conditions ticking away every hour during peak times for you to pick from now, so you won't have to stay up way past your bedtime to collect matriarch reactors or limited edition rubber ducks.

title: The memory crisis led me down a rabbit hole into nations forming rival factions to secure the flow of computer chips and AI, with names that wouldn't sound out of place in a Command & Conquer reboot
text:
PC gaming has a problem: high prices for a key component, due to an unforeseen surge of interest. We're in the thick of it, with no light at the end of the tunnel just yet, as supply will take a very long time to catch up to the outsized demand.
Wait, haven't we been here before?!
Sure we have, lots of times. We're likely to get here again, too, as politicians around the globe have turned the semiconductor biz hewn of globalisation into something to be controlled and influenced by newly-minted factions with names you'd expect to see in a new Command & Conquer game: Pax Silica and WAICO.
Hey, when are they making another of those games? Anyways, global silicon gangs. They're a thing now.
So, why is PC gaming so susceptible to the whims of global politics and trade? You don't have to go far back through the annals of PC Gamer to find the last time we spoke of some huge problem in PC gaming that sounds awfully similar to the memory crisis we're in today. Most recently, the closure and subsequent disruption of the Strait of Hormuz.
Our Jacob Fox recently spoke to various supply chain experts to gauge the impact of the US attack on Iran and subsequent closure of the Strait of Hormuz. He summarises it having an impact on Helium, sulphuric acid, PPE resin, aluminium, and naphtha. Each one used in some part of the semiconductor manufacturing process, affecting both chips and PCBs.
"You could see, in a worst case, allocation, scarcity-of-supply scenario where we're going to be choosing to focus on AI infrastructure versus consumer needs," Exiger SVP of Product Level Intelligence Derek Lemke told Jacob in May.
Not just for gaming, after all. (Image credit: Future) Prior to this action by US President Donald Trump, he imposed tariffs on a range of countries and goods, which in turn increased prices for the companies producing them and leading to higher sticker prices. That is, before being roundly rebuked by US Supreme Court and the funds returned .
Before that, the covid-19 pandemic. As the world came to a standstill and people moved away from offices and into their homes, demand for computers, consoles, standing desks, and exercise bikes erupted. Moreover, semiconductors were finally seen as a hot commodity by governments, and any weak links in supply chains were being interrogated, leading to the Biden administration and EU both announcing legislation to bring more cutting-edge semiconductor manufacturing to home soil.
Cutting-edge semiconductors that PC gaming is dependent on for many meaningful performance leaps over the years. PC gaming companies are some of the first to make the leap to bleeding-edge technologies, such as AMD when it rushed to utilise TSMC's 7 nm process for a competitive advantage for its CPUs and GPUs.
Neither US or EU legislation seemed to do much alone, by the way. Trump renegotiated the CHIPS Act and EU member states called for a second spin on the EU Chips Act, with the first attempt now deemed by European Court auditors to be "overly ambitious." Though both have played a part in refamiliarising politicians with semiconductor supply chains in a way that has led to some big and strange developments more recently. We'll get to those shortly.
While that crisis was developing , PC gaming was in a more acute pickle due to outsized demand for graphics cards for cryptocurrency. At-home cryptocurrency mining had already had an effect on PC gaming with the first GPU shortage of 2017-18, though it was really from 2020 that things got bad.
A cryptocurrency mining rig back from the days when that was actually a thing one could do. (Image credit: Лечение Наркомании, Pixabay) This continued through to 2022, when ethereum, the most popular cryptocurrency that could be mined on consumer-grade hardware (GPUs, rather than ASICs) shifted away from mining and turned to what's known as 'proof-of-stake' . Thus ending one of the worst periods in PC gaming that I covered personally—until today, anyways.
"If you break down to the DNA level of what goes into a chip, and you can look at the silicon that goes into the wafer, you can look at the metals and minerals that go into the circuitry, to some extent, every single one of those inputs has been hamstrung in some way," said Dr. Goldsby, a supply chain expert.
"So here we've got demand, on the one hand, that's just off the charts. And we've got the supply chain that is handicapped by virtue of getting access to materials, very constrained production capacity, and then slow transportation connecting the dots. You add it all up, and that's where we are right now."
Sound familiar? I'm not talking talking to Dr. Goldsby about the current memory crisis; this is from an article I wrote back in 2021 on why it was so difficult to buy a graphics card at that time. It's about the increase in demand from cryptocurrency miners at the same time as covid-19 supply issues. These are similar forces, the same patterns, that lead us to the mess we're back in again today.
I'm preaching to the choir. PC gamers having a solid understanding of the importance of supply chains and semiconductor technologies, it seems even exceeding many politicians, because it directly affects them. These things have an impact on their hobby, both good and bad, from better-performing processors to today's inflated prices.
The three major memory manufacturers: SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron. (Image credit: SeongJoon Cho / Bloomberg via Getty Images (left) | JHVEPhoto via Getty Images (middle) | David Paul Morris/Bloomberg via Getty Images (right)) Back to the present day, and we're looking at increased demand from AI, datacentres built out on an enormous scale (that's very unpopular, for good reason), and a reliance on three (excluding the latest Chinese wildcard, CXMT) major memory companies that have often appeared to resist large-scale plans for new facilities for producing and packaging memory chips to counter sudden increased demand due to fears of an oversupply and crashing prices.
Despite some amount of unpopularity with the public for how AI models are trained, run, and their output, governments are betting their countries' economic growth on AI. Datacentres are seen to be of an outsized import to a country's national interests. Take the UK government, for example, which is labelling these 'Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects (NSIP) and rolling out new legislation to avoid parts of the otherwise lengthy planning process. You don't want a datacentre whirring by your house all hours of the day? Well, tough.
All leading to political action on supply chains that spans continents, not countries. As I've been looking into the forces that manipulate the global semiconductor industry, I've stumbled across one recently formed organisation that hopes to have an impact on that very same thing: Pax Silica.
Yeah, it's really called that. They even have a motto: "Securing the silicon supply chain."
(Image credit: Pax Silica) Where else could a name as lofty and Roman come from other than the United States? Organised by the US Department of State , but signed by 24 countries , many of whom joined in December, 2025, the Pax Silica is an organisation that intends to secure "AI and supply chain security" and to advance "new economic security consensus among allies and trusted partners."
If the 20th century ran on oil and steel, the 21st century runs on compute and the minerals that feed it.
Jacob Helberg, US Under Secretary for Economic Affair
Of the many countries involved in the agreement—including the US, EU, South Korea, India, Israel, UK, Singapore, Philippines, Netherlands, Japan, and Qatar—the powerhouse of global semiconductor manufacturing, Taiwan, is only a "non-signatory participant" .
"If the 20th century ran on oil and steel, the 21st century runs on compute and the minerals that feed it," says Jacob Helberg, US Under Secretary for Economic Affairs. "This historic declaration hails a new economic security consensus ensuring aligned partners build the AI ecosystem of tomorrow—from energy and critical minerals to high-end manufacturing and models."
(Image credit: Tasos Katopodis/Getty Images for Undersecretary of State for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg) The idea being that frontier foundation AI models, semiconductors, infrastructure, manufacturing facilities, minerals, and the energy to run the lot are to be shared between signatories, and signatories are expected to collaborate on the next big thing.
There's a strong sense of addressing national security and righting wrongs in the name of "fair competition" throughout its founding documents. Nations are expected to coordinate responses to "overcapacity and dumping so that supply chains remain secure, resilient, and innovative over time" and "protect sensitive technologies and critical infrastructure from undue access or control by countries of concern."
You start to see where there's some tension coming in, right? It's not all about building fiber-optic cables to connect the world together in one big livestreamed kumbaya singalong.
There's more tension bubbling around Pax Silica, too. What of the countries that didn't sign up to it? On July 19, 2026, some of them announced their own organisation with a very similar sounding brief: The World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, or WAICO, stationed in Shanghai.
(Image credit: Getty Images) WAICO aims to be a cooperative agreement on AI, computing, and sharing frontier AI models among members that may have limited access to their own or other key players', such as those made by large US companies. WAICO was originally floated by China, and counts Russia among its backers, but says it is operating in the interests of the 'Global South', which includes many developing nations, and BRICS , though India is a BRICS member and a signatory of Pax Silica, not WAICO. Kazakhstan is oddly in both groups.
Essentially, you have the US-backed faction on one side and the China-backed faction on the other. Two rival factions trying to control the flow of chips and advancement of AI models across the globe. Both sides want to play a pivotal role in shaping AI and tussling with one another over whose vision for the future is best.
It's been reported in the past couple of days that the US is preparing to tell countries they must pick a side in this, too, with Reuters reporting countries could be barred from the US-led faction after having joined the one in Shanghai. Someone better tell Kazakhstan, then.
It's all politics at the end of the day, but politics that play a role in how viable our own hobby remains. Trump's tariffs are a prime example of when politics interfere with PCs, as are efforts to build more chips on US soil, even if costs to produce said chips are subsequently higher as a result .
(Image credit: Intel) PC gaming is a tiny speck being blown this way and that by these gargantuan powers, riding the global semiconductor trade that operates on talent and resources moving across the globe. When it comes to the affordability or availability of cutting-edge semiconductors, it's clear that nations are thinking plenty about AI capacity and a lot less about everyday consumers.
Neither group's messaging appears to take much heed of arguments against another technological arms race, which is sure to further damage the environment and use even more energy than it does already today. These are two groups that feel they can't take their foot off the gas and let the other 'win', but as a result will lead to us all losing to climate change in the long run.
So, if you're hoping the pressures that led to the memory crisis would ease as more capacity came online, that may offer short-term relief, but we're not out of the woods yet. It looks like we're only just kicking into a new gear when it comes to resource guarding semiconductors, fabs, and rare earth minerals—and all in the name of AI. Ugh.

title: The 3DMark Port Royal world record has been beaten, and all it took was a $5,000+ liquid nitrogen-cooled RTX 5090
text:
In news only nerds like me will care about (which is pretty much my raison d'être at this point), the world record for the highest 3DMark Port Royal score has been smashed. Shattered. Thrown into the mud. Soundly beaten.
Okay, so it's not by a huge amount over the previous record. But the new top score on HWBot is a massive 51,663 marks , and was achieved by user Cmaker. Take a bow, you king of overclockers. I kneel at your ability to make a large number go higher than everyone else.
In all seriousness, Cmaker's rig is something to behold. The score was achieved using an MSI RTX 5090 32G Lightning Z , a limited-edition extreme graphics card priced at $5,000+ upon release—and for god knows how much if you can find one today. It was also cooled with liquid nitrogen to achieve a top clock speed of 3,623 MHz, 848 MHz higher than the already-massive max "default" speed of 2,775 MHz.
As you would imagine, the rest of Cmaker's rig is suitably extreme to match. The CPU is the venerable Intel Core i9 14900KF (water cooled, of course), the 32 GB of Corsair Vengeance DDR5 has also had a dose of liquid nitrogen cooling, and the power supply is a 1,500 W Corsair unit.
Looking at the photos, it seems Cmaker has milled a custom cooling block for the RTX 5090 themselves, and surrounded the GPU and the motherboard with a smattering of fans. It's not the most put together gaming PC I've ever seen, but this sort of setup is par for the course when it comes to the world of extreme overclocking.
(Image credit: UL) For reference, our stock RTX 5090 FE sample managed a score of 36,389 in Port Royal, while the ludicrously expensive MSI RTX 5090 Suprim SOC topped out at 38,715. All it takes is an even more expensive RTX 5090 variant, some liquid nitrogen, a milling machine, and some talent, ey? If only we'd known.
But how long until the record is broken again? Come on, I know someone reading must have an even more extreme setup than this one—or at the very least, the resources required to put one together. I shall sit here and watch, because this sort of high-wire act with very expensive components makes my teeth hurt. Good stuff, though. Got any spare change?

title: The new Framework 12 laptop's secret weapon is its battery life courtesy of Intel's Wildcat Lake
text:
Framework has just announced a new version of its Framework 12 laptop that apparently gets a bunch more battery life. That's despite it keeping the same 50 Wh battery and thanks to Intel's Wildcat Lake processors.
The Framework 12 is the company's two-in-one (touch-and-type), low-power, entry-level offering, mainly used for study and light work. Previously it used low-power Raptor Lake-U (13th Gen) processors, but now ones that you pre-order will use fresh—but still low-power—Wildcat Lake, ie, Core Series 3, processors.
Framework currently lists a few options to choose from :
New Framework 12 options Max clock speed
Cores
Price
Core 3 304
4.3 GHz
1 P + 4 LPE
$549 / £549
Core 5 320
4.6 GHz
2 P + 4 LPE
$779 / £779
Core 7 350
4.8 GHz
2P + 4 LPE
$999 / £999
Those prices are, of course, base prices before adding on the other storage and memory to your DIY kit.
These processors obviously won't get you close to running any kind of heavy productivity tasks with ease, but for general day-to-day use they should be fine. It's also unlikely to be great for gaming, given even the top processor here, the Intel Core 7 350, has just two Xe (GPU) cores. Even Intel's newly-rumoured low-power handheld processor is said to have four.
That being said, the switch to Wildcat Lake, Framework claims, greatly improves battery life. The company is claiming 57% extra hours while browsing the web and 70% extra hours streaming Netflix. Those are some bold claims, but given what we've seen of Panther Lake's battery life (different processors but using the same 18A node), it's not beyond believability.
There are a number of other improvements, including:
Wi-Fi 7
Backlit keyboard
Thunderbolt 4
Fingerprint reader
Pre-installed Fedora Linux
Of course installing Linux isn't exactly difficult, but it's nice to see Fedora installed by default for those who just want to buy a laptop and get to it, right out of the box.
Fedora in particular is a great choice, in my not-so-humble opinion. It at least gave me a better time of things than many other distros did. But hey, I don't want to go sparking the perennial distro debates in the comments.
Other than those changes, you're getting the same convertible, two-in-one touch and type lappy as before.

title: I modded GTA 5 into a life-sim RPG with mining, foraging, a mini-economy, and the ability to fall asleep in the middle of the road
text:
Grand Theft Auto 6 will, I'm assured, be the most immersive videogame of all time. You simply won't be able to discern reality from fiction anymore. Your gaze will drift from your television, to outside, to the television, to outside, and the sheer fidelity of Rockstar's opus will be such that you can no longer tell the slightest difference between the two. You will utterly lose your mind. It's gonna be great.
GTA 5, though? Hardly immersive at all by comparison. If I'm going to successfully mod this game into GTA 6, I'm going to need to rectify that. So I did.
(Image credit: Rockstar) I have installed Roleplay Alone , a mod which turns Rockstar's crime sandbox into a sort of pseudo life sim, filled with all manner of strange little jobs for Michael, Franklin, and Trevor to get up to. Thrill as you mine various ores! Marvel as you package and distribute cannabis! Be amazed as you smelt things at a cement mixer somehow!
I immediately set about my new labours. Franklin, in a $3000 cashmere jumper, manifested a two-handed mattock and began chipping away at some rocks. He did this with one hand for reasons of either incredible strength or limited animations.
This took some time. So long, in fact, that Franklin got a little bit tired according to Roleplay Alone's newly-added energy meter. I found a rhythm: convert a few boulders to ore, then tap Y to crumple to the floor, fully clothed—as if struck down by an assassin's bullet—to regain my depleted energy. Fortunately, the various hard-hatted men in the quarry did not mind that A) I was mining all their rocks or B) sleeping on the floor.
(Image credit: Rockstar) Is GTA 5 rendered uncannily immersive by Roleplay Alone? Well. No. But it is very entertaining to set the game's protagonists to blue-collar tasks like mining and ore-smelting, and even more entertaining when you're doing something completely different, forget what the Y key does now, and find yourself collapsed asleep in the road like the world's most narcoleptic crime lord.
I do not think I will spend a lot of time mining—if for no other reason than doing it for about 15 minutes netted me only enough fake currency to buy a burger—but it's good to know I could . Just like I could in real life. Maybe.
And besides, I can fish now.
(Image credit: Rockstar)

title: Epic Mickey creator Warren Spector is 'a little bitter' that his studio isn't getting props for sparking Oswald the Lucky Rabbit's big comeback
text:
Epic Mickey man Warren Spector—also known for other games you may have heard of, like Ultima Underworld, System Shock, and Deus Ex—recently took to LinkedIn to share some thoughts about Disney's upcoming Oswald the Lucky Rabbit miniseries, which was showcased by Jon Favreau at the recent D23 event. Spector said he's "seriously looking forward to it," but he's also a little annoyed by what he sees as the erasure of the game that helped bring the character back into the public consciousness.
Favreau provided a brief overview of Oswald's creation in the 1920s during his presentation, relating how creator Walt Disney lost the rights to the character shortly thereafter. While numerous Oswald shorts were produced, the character was utterly overshadowed by Disney's subsequent creation, Mickey Mouse, and languished in obscurity for years. Disney reacquired the rights to Oswald in 2006, and "we've seen him pop up in games and in shorts and things" since then, Favreau said—and, well, that's the extent of it.
That didn't sit right with Spector, who made Oswald a major NPC in Epic Mickey, and a playable character in Epic Mickey 2: The Power of Two. "I’m seriously looking forward to it but it seems as if people are looking at it as the debut of the character," Spector wrote. "Call me small-minded but that ain’t right.
"In the Epic Mickey game—released in 2010—the team at Junction Point featured Oswald in his first Disney role since 1928. Two years later, in Epic Mickey: The Power of Two, we gave him a voice (thanks to the incredible talent of Frank Welker). That was the first time he ever spoke in a Disney story. And just to put a cherry on top, we gave Ortensia her name, her voice, her personality and her role as Oswald’s paramour. None of that dates back to Disney."
Spector admitted he's "a little bitter about the lack of credit the team gets" for all the work they put into bringing such a foundational character back into the public eye. But his real concern is simply ensuring the record remains accurate.
"I was blown away that Disney trusted us and saw fit to reintroduce the little guy in a game," he wrote. "But the team did a great job and deserves to be recognized for it before Hollywood makes people forget the games ever existed."
One of the challenges facing Spector here is that the Epic Mickey games were, well, forgettable , despite some striking concept art . The original was a Nintendo Wii exclusive that posted middling reviews and sales alike; it didn't come to PC and other platforms until the Rebrushed Edition in 2024, which holds "very positive" reviews on Steam—perhaps in part because of the presence of Deus Ex DNA that writer Jeremy Peel detected in it. 2012's Epic Mickey 2 sold even fewer copies than the first game, though, and Junction Point was closed just a couple months after its release.
None of which invalidates Spector's point: Junction Point pulled Oswald out of the past and gave the character a depth and distinctiveness it never had when it was merely a Mickey precursor. It deserves credit for doing so, and hopefully as the Oswald series comes closer to fruition—it's set to debut sometime in 2027—Disney will make an effort to ensure Junction Point gets it.

title: The new Rusty Lake game is a grim, sinister tale of family, destiny, and cooking: I fed a man porridge filled with dead bugs and he told me it tasted good
text:
Crunch the incessant off ness of Twin Peaks into a surprisingly beefy collection of point-and-click puzzle adventures and you've got Rusty Lake: Twisted tales of familial obligation and tradition unfolding in a backcountry idyll possessed by something better left unseen and unspoken. Imagine if ol' Eddie Allen P. had been born a couple centuries later and took up game development, and you'll have a pretty good idea of the vibe. I've been looking forward to the latest addition to the series, Servant of the Lake , for quite some time now, and now that it's out I'm happy to say that it is very good.
Servant of the Lake is something of a slow burn—I've been playing through it over the last four nights, and the first half of the game was suitably weird but more subdued than I expected. But once it starts rolling, the Vanderboom family at the center of the tale does not hold back.
If you're familiar with Rusty Lake, Servant of the Lake is 100% in keeping with that tradition. It feels a little less forcefully bizarre than some other games in the series, and with a greater emphasis on mystery than horror. One thing that struck me is the game's audio: The voice work is great but less disconnected from humanity than I remember from previous games, and the soundtrack is actually quite pleasant, particularly as the game progresses. It's all still unsettling, but I wonder if Rusty Lake (which is also the name of the development team) wanted to avoid distracting from the story too much, for… reasons .
Even so, weird is the Rusty Lake playbook and that's definitely still the case. Servant of the Lake is ostensibly about signing on for a three-day gig as a servant in support of a big family reunion, but the work involved is not your everyday household drudgery. I fed a man porridge infested with houseflies, then cut off a chunk of his ear while shaving him, both of which he seemed oddly okay with—and this was on my first morning.
Later on I tried to kill a guy, and then watched a lady swallow a soul. What a weekend!
Puzzles in Servant of the Lake are fairly lightweight, and if you do get hung up (as I did, once) there's plenty of help to be had from the community and the developers themselves, who have posted a full walkthrough . It's also very linear: There are moments where it seems like you have a choice in matters, but your fate is predetermined so you don't need to agonize over, say, the soup . (You'll figure it out.)
Like other Rusty Lake games, what Servant of the Lake offers in place of freedom is secrets: The game is filled with them, and while they're not essential to the experience, they do add to the ambiance, sometimes with references to previous games in the series. There's a lot to dig into, and fortunately all chapters are replayable in any order once the game is finished, so it's easy to go back and dig for what you missed.
I'm also happy to see that Servant of the Lake is making a good impression on other Rusty Lake fans. Less than a week after release, it holds an "overwhelmingly positive" rating on Steam across more than 4,500 reviews. Rusty Lake co-founder Robin Ras said it was "a great launch," on par with the release of 2022's The Past Within , the studio's most successful game to date.
"Steam is our biggest platform and had a big peak of 28,000 concurrent users on the first day," Ras told me. " It seems a lot of fans wanted to play the game immediately. We already have more than 4,000 reviews, with an average of 98%."
As for what comes next, Ras said the team has "plenty of ideas" for the future, and it's also currently helping with another dark adventure, Falling Apart, that it's publishing through the studio's Second Maze label. "But first, we will focus a bit more on Servant of the Lake, because there’s more to it than people might think. :)"
I assume the smile is at least partly meant to be ominous.
Servant of the Lake is available now on Steam with a 25% launch discount, putting it at $6/£6/6€ until August 27. If you'd like to get a taste before you take a big bite, there;'s also a free demo .

title: 2 seemingly real GTA 6 clips—and maybe the full map—just leaked online
text:
Two seemingly genuine Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay clips are making the rounds online.
The first, a minute-long clip originally posted by a group or individual named "Cyberleek", is already being reposted in multiple places, but we first noticed it via gaming forum ResetEra . As of writing, the clip already has more than 100,000 views.
In the clip, we see protagonist Jason Duval at an oceanside house—the same one that we've seen in trailers. The player jumps over his deck and onto the driveway, where he picks up a basketball and shoots some hoops. For sinking a basket, the player increases their "Focus" by 2%. We see two cash totals listed in the HUD—presumably one for their on-hand cash, and one for their bank.
Another clip, posted almost an hour later, shows the player driving around a beat-up car, crashing into a delivery truck, and then attacking the driver.
Elsewhere, Cyberleek has also published supposed screenshots of the in-game map, though art has appears too simple to be how it will actually look in the game. Below one image is a message from Cyberleek, which claims that the leaks are motivated by Rockstar's decision not to release a physical version of GTA 6. The image also includes links to various websites where it asks for money, though I wouldn't rush to visit them.
The apparent leak comes in the final days before GTA 6's proper gameplay reveal, which is going down August 27 exclusively on Netflix for the first six hours.

title: How to get Chromite in Palworld
text:
Chromite isn't actually rare in Palworld , but you've got to have a specific tool (or pal) to mine it, which is different from most other resources. To save you from the guesswork, I'll show you how to use a metal detector to get Chromite initially and also a passive farming solution for bigger hauls so you're set up to make your first batch of Hexolite when you're ready.
Palworld Chromite location
Prepare for a visit to Feybreak Island
(Image: © Pocketpair)
Chromite is found underground on Feybreak Island , just south of Mount Obsidian, but you'll need to craft a Metal Detector or catch a Smokie to assist in digging it up. Using Smokie's partner skill is the easiest way to farm early on, but I'd recommend crafting a Metal Detector if you have the spare materials. It's expensive to make, but it's much faster and won't take up a pal slot.
Use Smokie's partner skill
Catch a wild Smokie roaming Feybreak Island
Craft and equip Smokie's Harness (from the Level 58 tech tree)
Use the Pal Essence Condenser to improve its skill
Craft a Metal Detector
Unlock the blueprint from Level 58 on the tech tree
Requires : 30 Plasteel, 100 Paldium Fragments, 15 Computers, 20 Nightstar Sand
The Metal Detector is easy to use and automatically scans the soil around you as you explore. If you use Smokie's partner skill you've got to spam it by pressing the E key while you walk around instead. When either method detects Chromite, a rocky node (highlighted by a blue beacon) sprouts from the ground. Harvest it with a pickaxe, just like you would any other ore.
Easy Chromite farm
Breed Smokies for a passive Chromite farm
(Image: © Pocketpair)
If you don't mind the wait, passively farm Chromite by hatching little Smokies . Don't get too attached, because those Dark Eggs are headed to slaughter. Here's the whole process:
Catch one male and one female Smokie
Leave them at the Breeding Farm with regular Cake, or use Vegetable Cakes to double up on eggs
Hatch your continuous supply of Smokie eggs
Use the Pal Disassembly Conveyor to butcher the Smokies
Collect the Chromite they leave behind
It's a grim process, but hey, it works. The remains of every Smokie you put in the conveyor should drop Chromite, so long as you don't mind the wait for eggs it's an easy, passive alternative to hunting down nodes around the map.

title: Former PlayStation boss Shuhei Yoshida told Clair Obscur devs to not call it a 'turn-based RPG' so people wouldn't 'overlook' it
text:
According to former PlayStation boss Shuhei Yoshida, turn-based RPGs, particularly JRPGs, were so unpopular several years ago that he would tell indie developers to avoid using the term altogether in their marketing—even for a game like Clair Obscur: Expedition 33.
Yoshida recalled giving the Clair Obscur developers this advice during a lecture at the Busan Indie Connect Festival 2026 (via Automaton ). He was impressed by a demo he played a couple of years before the game was out, particularly its similarities to The Legend of Dragoon, a game he produced, but recommended the developers at Sandfall Interactive find alternative ways to describe its combat.
"It's incredibly well-made, but it would be better not to call it a turn-based RPG," he said. "That alone might cause players to overlook it."
Sandfall listened and started describing Clair Obscur's combat as "reactive turn-based battles" in its marketing. It's hard to tell if that actually had an impact on the breakout success of the game, but it probably didn't hurt.
Even if you set aside the supposed genre stigma, I think calling Clair Obscur a turn-based RPG does undercut how active the combat actually feels. It isn't the kind of game where you can get up and grab a snack in between turns. You're encouraged to study how enemies move so you can time all your dodges and parries, as if you're playing a soulslike.
Did adding a single word before "turn-based" change everything? I'm not convinced it was the sole reason the game caught people's attention when it already looked fast-paced in trailers. But it does speak to the tendency for many games in the genre to only appeal to people who grew up with them, and the number of people who fall asleep when threatened with having to take turns during the action.
Thankfully, Clair Obscur has helped make turn-based games cool again. It sold 3.3 million copies in the first month and has since surpassed eight million copies as of April. Yoshida believes Clair Obscur is a great example of why chasing industry trends isn't always the right move. He also said that publishers have started to see a slew of turn-based games pitched to them in the wake of Clair Obscur's explosive success.

title: 15 details from the new GTA 6 leaks, including a possible morality system and stamina meter
text:
A pair of clips purportedly showing Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay footage have appeared online , along with several images of an in-game map of Leonida, the Florida-inspired state where GTA 6 takes place.
Rockstar has not confirmed whether or not the clips are genuine, but they look legit to our eyes, with the caveat that even if they are, they could come from an outdated build of the game. Both clips look like the kind of thing a tester would capture, in that they're relatively mundane gameplay scenes, not the type of stuff you'd see in a trailer.
In both clips, the player is controlling Jason, one of GTA 6's two protagonists. In one clip, the player shoots a basketball outside Jason's dilapidated waterfront home. In the other, their car gets clipped by a delivery truck, and then they go full road rage homicide on the poor delivery driver before scrambling to get away from incoming police. The clip ends just as the player drives up to a helicopter that looks ripe for stealing.
The clips are circulating through the usual social media channels, and some reuploads have already been taken down. We're not posting them here, but they're out there for the curious to find.
With the caveat again that we don't know the exact provenance or recency of these clips—a group called "Cyberleek" has taken credit for posting them—we've picked out the most notable details here. Our first official look at GTA 6 gameplay is scheduled to arrive next week, first on Netflix .
Wanted level
The wanted level can reach six stars: that's one more than in GTA 5! It appears beating a delivery driver to death with a pipe wrench will get you a mere two stars.
Police ID
When you commit a crime and the cops are after you, they ID you with three categories, as seen in the top right corner of the screen: your clothing (an icon shows a hanger), possibly your face or hair color (shown with a blank face icon), and your car (a car icon). Presumably changing your clothing or car (or repainting it as in other GTA games) while wanted can help you escape.
Stamina
From the moment Jason starts throwing punches at that angry delivery driver what appears to be a stamina meter starts depleting. When he starts beating him to death with a wrench, the stamina depletes all the way to zero. The edges of the screen start to vignette, and I'd wager no stamina means some sort of movement penalty.
Stealth
The cops pull up after Jason beats the Scoop driver to death, and we see something new to GTA here: a blue stealth indicator arrow that tracks how close the cops are to noticing the player. Based on how brazen the player is being, the time it takes to fully alert law enforcement seems pretty generous—maybe you can play GTA 6 stealthily, if you choose?
This is not a leaked image. This is an official image, as are all the rest on this page. (Image credit: Rockstar) Focus
It looks like we'll be improving the traits of Jason and Lucia just like we did with Arthur Morgan in RDR2. We see Jason sink a basketball and gain +2% Focus. Called shot, but I'm guessing that trait has something to do with slo-mo bullet time.
Hoops
Speaking of basketball, when Jason is shooting hoops in his driveway, he uses a simple "press the button when the rings overlap" system.
Negative karma
GTA 6 might judge you for your actions in a similar way to Red Dead Redemption 2's karma system. As Jason pummels the delivery driver, we see a little devil icon on the right with a minus symbol. Sure looks like the evil side of a karma system. Interestingly, the symbol doesn't appear until he starts beating the unconscious man—perhaps the game won't judge you for starting fights with locals, but it will for senseless murder?
(Image credit: Rockstar) Cars have a gas and engine meter
Fill 'er up! Looks like you'll need to monitor your vehicle's gas level (a popular mod for GTA 5 lets you do this, so I guess Rockstar incorporated it fully into GTA 6) and engine condition. The trunk and bed of the car also shows "loadout" and "storage 0/4" menu options.
Money and budget
In the hoops clip, we see Jason has two dollar amounts shown in the upper right corner: $39 (presumably his cash on hand) and $1,643 next to a house icon. The circle around the house is filled only a tiny bit, so that could indicate that he's got rent due, or perhaps that's how much money he's got stashed in the bank (similar to how it works in GTA Online).
Fake brands spotted
Sea Shark (jetski), Scoop (delivery company), 24/7 Supermarket, Arrow (gas station), Hamilton Private Health Clinic (last word is blurry, but "clinic" fits), Fast Pass EMS (on an ambulance).
(Image credit: Rockstar) Tunes
The song in the second clip is Impact by SG Lewis, Robin, and Channel Tres—pretty apropos for slamming a car into a delivery truck. You can listen to it on YouTube .
Player character locations shown
The map image leak shows a car icon with a "J" over it. It appears this image was taken while the player was inhabiting Lucia (the arrow indicating the player location is over the water, so Lucia might be on a boat or aircraft), and the map shows the location of Jason elsewhere in Leonida. This is a change from GTA 5, where you didn't know where the other playable characters were on the map unless you swapped into them or happened to run into them.
Racetracks
The map leak shows what looks like several small race tracks across Leonida: racing cars could be an activity or a way to make money.
(Image credit: Rockstar) Jason's house location
Jason's house is shown on the map, too: it's in southern Leonida on one of the islands of the Keys.
Military base
I'm wondering if the airport shown at the very end of the Keys is the military base. There's a large airport shown in Vice City, so this smaller airport could be the place to steal fighter jets: though it'd be quite a long drive if you wanted to take a tank into downtown Vice City.

title: Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker says they won't stop until Rockstar and Take-Two apologize for 'anti-consumerism' and make a 'concrete commitment to do better'
text:
Cyberleek, the group or person (it's not clear which) behind today's big Grand Theft Auto 6 leak , claims it's not just doing it for the lulz. In a manifesto calling out industry practices it finds objectionable, Cyberleek warned that it will continue targeting publishers who violate its edicts.
"Publishers sell licenses and call them purchases," the document states. "They ship unfinished games and call them living services. They lock content on discs and call it DLC. They kill games and keep the money. Every year anti-consumerism tightens its grip, and every year gamers get less for what they pay."
Cyberleek said it's "raising funds for a secret project," presumably through the sale of a memecoin—of course there's a memecoin—which will be "directed toward the infrastructure needed to strike, as well as the security and protection required to withstand the inevitable corporate counterattacks."
They also listed three "commandments" in the manifesto—no digital preorders, no "fake" (ie, already part of the game data) singleplayer DLC, and mandatory "offline fallback states" for singleplayer games—and warned that publishers who violate them will be subject to sanction: "Cyberleek will not stop until they issue a public statement and apology with a concrete commitment to be better. Words are not enough; restitution is mandatory."
It's all very dramatic in a "Remember, remember" way, and certainly overegged; there's also an irony, perhaps unintentional, in holding forth on consumer rights while pumping crypto. Regardless of motivations, though, this is surely a headache Rockstar and Take-Two could do without. There's been no public comment yet, but copyright strikes against the leaks have been flying fast and furious, rather strongly suggesting that these leaks are legit.
Cyberleek's bravado may be its undoing (because isn't that always the way) and its ability to follow through on its threats is obviously a big question. But with Grand Theft Auto 6 now just three months away from release on consoles—and the big Netflix reveal coming next week—it might be able to do some real damage before the curtain falls.
I've reached out to Take-Two and Rockstar for comment and will update if I receive a reply.

title: 'Live-service is a red flag for us': Why one publisher is embracing an older kind of multiplayer hit: peer-to-peer, server browsers, and organic community
text:
It's a frustrating thing to watch good games disappear. We've seen it happen time and time and time again: studios spend years on a cool multiplayer thing, bank on it being popular enough to become a live-service hit, then toss the entire project into the trash when that doesn't happen.
That could have been the fate of Deceive Inc , a 2023 'PvP Hitman' shooter that has attracted a passionate, but small community. Developer Sweet Bandits supported the game with substantial updates and microtransactions for over a year, but unfortunately shut down in 2024, leaving fans to assume Deceive Inc would one day disappear, too. Then last month, the unexpected happened : an update on its Steam page announced that not only would Deceive Inc not be going offline, but work is underway on community server tools and mod support that will essentially give the game to the community, and keep it playable forever.
The update is not the work of Sweet Bandits, but an initiative of Deceive Inc's publisher, Tripwire Interactive. In an interview with PC Gamer, publishing director Bryan West explained why Tripwire—which also publishes the Chivalry games and makes the Killing Floor series—is going to such lengths to maintain a game that only a few people are playing.
"The core message is that Tripwire wants players to be able to enjoy our games for as long as they want to enjoy them. So we fight and claw to find a way to make that happen," West said.
"We don't want to leave our games in a broken state. It's a mandate from our leadership, and it's part of the reason why I'm happy to be with Tripwire."
A preview of the server tools coming to Deceive Inc. (Image credit: Sweet Bandits) Custom server tools and community browsers were once the norm for PC games, but in the age of matchmaking algorithms and expected cross-play functionality, multiplayer games are built around closed networking and dedicated servers. Undoing that process for Deceive Inc is not a small task, as West explains:
"It's several months of work for a very high-level engineer. It's not inconsequential, but in terms of the gains, I would say it's very important for Tripwire as a business that relies on its reputation with gamers. It's important for us to look at the long term and not the short term of how this is impacting our bottom line.
"We feel like being able to continue to sell Deceive, and not shut it down, is going to be a net win over the long haul," West said. "Plus, we get to look gamers in the eye, metaphorically, and say this is important to us. That when we sell you a game, you're able to continue playing it for as long as you want to."
Or to put it simply: "We have a lot of belief in Deceive Inc as a game, and we know that there's a community. We want to be able to continue selling it, to have it out there, to have people enjoy it."
(Image credit: Sweet Bandits) The live service problem
West described Deceive Inc as a learning experience for Tripwire. The publisher signed the game amidst the Covid boom, when folks were staying home playing games and investment was easier to come by.
"We poured our hearts and souls into it right alongside Sweet Bandits," West recounted. "Launch went well, but it obviously didn't blow up the way we had hoped. It presents itself as a more friendly game on the surface, but when you get into it, it's a very hardcore shooter at its core."
The conceit of Deceive Inc is spies versus spies: squads of three don civilian disguises and act like NPCs (similar to the old Assassin's Creed multiplayer modes) while completing tasks. When a match really comes together, it's one of the most unique competitive games I've ever played—channeling Hitman, SpyParty, and hero shooters all at once.
"Our hope was that an 'Among Us' perspective of hiding in plain sight and trying to use stealth would have been more of the meta," West said, "but when it got to the actual audience, it was apparent the shooter aspects took over."
(Image credit: PC Gamer, Tripwire) That hardcore meta made the game less broadly accessible and matchmaking increasingly sweaty, but it "resonated with the people that figured out how to play, and three-plus years later, there's still a core community that gets together and runs sessions."
Before the studio's closure, Sweet Bandits and Tripwire made changes to aid new players, like bot matches and rules that discourage open combat, but "by that time it's really hard to recover."
"It's got that window, and unless you get extremely lucky, it's hard to ever recapture [momentum]," said West. "We love the game, and it has done well for us as a whole, but it was not enough to sustain a studio, even a small studio, in the live ops framework. That was a huge lesson for me."
The experience changed Tripwire's perspective on live-service games. What worked for Chivalry 2 won't work for other games, and as a decision maker, West is now more interested in products built to last.
(Image credit: Sweet Bandits Studios) "As a publishing director reviewing stuff regularly, I'd say any small team that's looking to do that live-service model is a red flag for us," he said. "We are looking for and prioritizing games that either have peer-to-peer setups, or something like what we're doing with Deceive Inc right now, where it's more community server-run."
West calls it the "Valheim approach, where you can hook up however you want, and there's not that crazy ongoing cost. There will be big games and certain franchises where [live-service] makes sense, but on the whole, that's where we've pivoted our thinking."
Sounds like music to my ears. The old ways really do feel like the only way for inherently niche multiplayer games. For Deceive Inc—a complex, crunchy social stealth game—West reckons that firing up a custom server with friends will be not only a good option, but the best one.
"Call it its second life. The 'friend game night' type of game seems to be really coming into its own, and I think that is just a perfect way to experience Deceive, with a handful of friends on Discord giving each other grief," he said. "You might play it only once a month or something, but you've got your rotation of games you're playing, and it just fits in there. I think that's perfect."
Deceive Inc is still up on Steam and very much alive. The beta for its custom server tools is coming sometime soon.

title: Industry legend Warren Spector is retiring: 'I'm feeling like I've done what I set out to do'
text:
Warren Spector is one of the industry's most storied developers, particularly among fans of immersive sims. His leading roles on games like Ultima Underworld , System Shock , and Deus Ex —and you know what, even Invisible War and Deadly Shadows , which are probably better than you think—established him as one of the field's most admired and enduring names. And now, after doing it for more than 40 years, he's calling it a day.
"Let me cut right to the chase. I'm retiring from game development," Spector wrote on LinkedIn . "At least I think so. I've been here before and changed my mind but this time I'm pretty sure I mean it."
Spector said he's had a "great career" and wouldn't change a thing, but added that he's coming up on 44 years as a developer, a span that's seen him work on tabletop RPGs, board games, and "more digital games than [he] can remember," as part of teams ranging in size from a dozen people to 800. "I've worked for big companies and done startups," he wrote. "I like to think I've helped some insanely talented people along in their careers. (That last is the most important.)
"With all that behind me and with age and health (my business) catching up with me I'm feeling like I've done what I set out to do. It's time to write some books, do a lot of reading, do some lecturing, maybe do some consulting. (Feel free to get in touch about those last two.) Also there's a keyboard here just waiting for me to get my piano chops back."
That reflects something I've always respected and admired about Spector: He's commonly held up as the "creator" of this game or that (I do it myself) but he's made a point in the past of reminding people that these aren't solo ventures.
"You don't ship anything, let alone anything good, without a great team. The Deus Ex concept may have been mine, but the game itself, and all kudos aimed at it, belong to the great, great team that bought into a vision and made it a reality," he said in 2025 , marking the 25th anniversary of Deus Ex. More recently, he took a similar stance with Epic Mickey, calling out Disney for failing to give "the team at Junction Point" proper credit for bringing Oswald the Lucky Rabbit back into the public eye.
Spector said he has mixed feelings about his retirement, saying there are three games in particular he'd still like to make: "One is very big... one is very small... and one I don't know how to make which scares me." But the business has changed, "and it's just not as much fun" anymore—and, he added, "there's a new generation of developers coming up who deserve their time in the sun."
He also hasn't had much luck with his more recent venture at Otherside Entertainment, where he serves as studio director. Otherside's debut game, Underworld Ascendant , was a catastrophe, and while Thick as Thieves , released earlier this year, came out in far better shape, it failed to catch on with players and ended content updates just a couple months later. The studio had also been working on System Shock 3, but that came to an unhappy end in 2020 when the project was taken over by Tencent and, as far as anyone knows, subsequently left to die. It's doubly unfortunate because those are exactly the kind of games Spector is known for and should be able to crush, but it just hasn't worked out.
Despite that, I'll always hold out hope that Spector comes back someday, but mixed feelings or not, he does sound ready to pass the torch. "I want you to remember that games are not a solved problem yet—there is, I hope, plenty of experimentation and innovation to come," he concluded. "And to all you young developers out there, I've said it before and I'll say it again, your job is to make people forget people like me ever existed.
"Will I come back? Never say never. But I think it's time to ride off into the sunset. Now stop reading and make great games."
